jobs.title: Project Coordinator, Institutes
jobs.description:
**Work Location**

Orange, California  

**Work Shift**

Day – 08hrs (United States of America)  
  

**Why RCH?**

At RCH, we strive to be the leading destination of children’s health by providing exceptional and innovative care. We are responsible for the overall health of our community’s pediatric population in our hospitals, clinics, and practices. And because of our breadth of care, your career at RCH can be as diverse and fulfilling as you determine. RCH’s compensation structure, benefits offerings, and career development programs are geared to helping you achieve your professional and personal goals. Apply now to see where your career at RCH can take you.

**Environmental Sustainability Statement**

Driven by the connection between children's health and a healthy environment, we commit to creating a healthcare model that incorporates environmental sustainability aligned with our mission to protect children's health and patient safety.

**Job Summary**

The Coordinator, Special Projects is responsible for working collaboratively across all facets of the department to provide project coordination for business and clinical programs and services, including initiatives focused on program growth, clinical excellence, and operational excellence. This role will support strategic projects and initiatives across CHOC’s four core institutes: Heart, Neuroscience, Cancer, and Orthopedics, partnering with institute leaders and cross-functional teams to help advance key priorities across these areas.
  
  
This position assists with all phases of a project, from planning and execution through completion. The Coordinator develops work plans, tracks progress, and provides status updates, while collecting and analyzing internal metrics and performance data to monitor trends and identify opportunities for program improvement.
  
  
The position also performs other essential duties in support of associate, department, and business initiatives, including executive-level administrative and support functions, and regularly interacts with CHOC associates, management, outside consultants, and vendors.

**Pay Range**

Minimum $29.48 Midpoint $39.04 Maximum $48.61

*Rate of pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to knowledge, skills, competencies, experience, education, as well as position requirements.*

**Experience**

* Required: One ( 1) year of experience in a n administrative assistant, coordinator or role in a related field .

* Preferred: Prior experience three (3) years within the healthcare industry, performance improvement, and/ or coordinating projects.

**Education**
  

* Minimum: Bachelor's degree

* Preferred: M aster’s degree, Project management credential

**Training**
  

* Required: None.

* Preferred: Project Management principles, budget management principles.

**Specialized Skills**
  

* Required: Strong knowledge of Microsoft suite of programs – Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint, SharePoint . Ability to set goals and judge results in accordance with the highest standards; care with sensitivity and respect; advance care through development of new ideas and technology; promote teamwork to achieve CHOC’s mission; and understand and exceed customer expectations. This individual must have excellent communication skills both written and verbally . Ensure execution and compliance of processes, methods and tools. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Personal effectiveness skills such as time management and setting and achieving goals.

**Licensure**

* Required: None
* Preferred: Program Management Prof (PgMP), Project Management Prof (PMP).

**Work Environments - Functional Demand:**

Sedentary - Very light energy level Lift 10 lbs. box overhead. Lift and carry 15 lbs. Push/pull 20 lbs. cart.

**Physical Activity Requirements:**
-----------------------------------

Bending, Carry Objects, Climbing, Keyboard use/repetitive motion, Pinching/fine motor activities, Push/Pull, Reaching forward, Reaching overhead, Sitting, Squat/kneel/crawl (Squad & Knee), Standing, Talk or hear, Taste or smell, Twisting, Walking, Wrist position deviation

**Physical Activity Lifting**

Lifting (Floor to waist level) - Occasional 0-35%, Lifting (Waist level and above) - Occasional 0-35%

**Sensory Requirements:**

Color Discrimination, Depth Perception, Far Vision, Hearing, Near Vision

**Environment Requirements:**

Airborn Communicable Disease, Bloodborne Pathogens, Chemical, Dust Particular Matter, Extreme Noise Levels, Extreme Temperatures, Radiation, Uneven Surfaces or Elevations

RCH does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, marital status, genetic information, disability, sex, gender (including pregnancy, breastfeeding, childbirth, lactation or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, medical condition, sexual orientation, veteran status, military or uniformed service member status, or other protected characteristics in accordance with state and federal laws. RCH will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories, in accordance with the Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring.

  
  

We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply for positions at RCH, even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with the listed qualifications for a particular role, as your unique experience may be a great addition to our culture for another one of our opportunities.

jobs.title: Relocation Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Cumming Group, you will work on some of the world's most exciting projects in a dynamic environment where your success is measured by the impact you make. We are one of the fastest-growing project and cost management consultancies in the United States, as reflected in our top 15 rankings in ENR. With over 70 offices globally, an extremely diverse project portfolio, and double-digit year-over-year revenue growth, the opportunities to make your mark are limitless!

  
  
  

We are currently hiring a Relocation Project Coordinator to work within our Education project sector in Los Angeles, CA. This role supports the relocation project team within a large community college school district and will support all FF&E activities and move management activities for multiple college campuses in the greater Los Angeles area.

  
  

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities:**

* Support the Furniture/Equipment/Relocation Project Management Services with emphasis in FF&E selection, procurement coordination and purchasing for all such areas as identified by the school district to provide the onsite FF&E and move-in/relocations management services. Responsibilities include strategic oversight of all FF&E procurement, FF&E Installation, Pre-move, Move, and Post move/Close-out phase activities for specified assigned projects. Services shall be provided at the direction of the College Project Director (CPD) and the Manager of Relocation Project Management team.
* Assist with the procurement and purchasing of FF&E using best-value and/or low bid public contracting.
* Support budget and schedule tracking efforts for FF&E and moves, and meet with relevant Project Architects (A/E), and Project Managers to be able to prepare office layouts and work with the occupants to plan furniture and equipment relocation of existing to the move location. Work with vendors and/or movers to assist with filling in equipment and furnishings where there are gaps.
* Coordinate and prepare a list of all new furniture and equipment needed for the project.
* Assist with the timely and successful onsite FF&E installation, punch-list sign-off and transition during swing space, relocation and/or move into new buildings.
* Support the procurement of specialty contractors or Movers for installations, delivery, and/or connections not covered by the FF&E vendors. Create detailed scope of work for Task Orders for Contractors/Movers as necessary.
* Support the Relocation PM in working with the Project Interior Designer and the building user groups to select and prepare a list of all furniture and equipment needed for the project.
* Assist in the onsite unlocking of all areas requiring access by the movers and others during the Pre-Move, Move, Installation and Post Move/Close-Out Phases and for the re-securing all such areas.
* Assist in the onsite coordination of all furniture and equipment deliveries with PMs, CPDs, Facility Directors, and BUGs if applicable; work closely with Asset Management Team to coordinate all asset tagging and disposition requirements, and Warranty Program Managers and other members of program staff working towards close-out of projects.
* Maintain all FF&E, move management, moving and storage related documents, including proposals, purchase orders, packing slips, time cards, shipping documents, freight bills, and invoices.
  

  

**Knowledge & Skills Required:**

* Ability to provide update and status reports for work in progress including cost and schedules.
* Experience with set-up and document control.
* Ability to read architectural and furniture drawing.
* Knowledge of furniture and equipment specifications and procurement.
* Knowledge of AutoCAD software.
* Strong written and oral communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to be onsite at multiple project sites. Flexibility in schedule and transportation to work at multiple locations based on assigned schedule.
  

  
  

**Preferred Education and Experience:**

* High School diploma required. Bachelor degree in Architecture, Interior Design, Interior Architecture, Construction Management, Facilities Management, or related field is preferred.
* A minimum of one (1) year of related experience in Interior Design, Construction, Engineering, Moves/Relocations, Facilities, or Furniture, Fixture and Equipment coordination/procurement.
* Procurement, sourcing, or asset management experience is preferred.
* Public works experience in preferred.
* Certification/Membership with CID, IIDA, AIA, IFMA, and LEED is preferred.
  

  

*Cumming Group is committed to providing Equal Employment Opportunity in its personnel policies and practices. It is Cumming Group’s policy to recruit, hire, train and promote Team Members and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, sex, marital status, registered domestic partner status, genetic information, sexual preference, sexual orientation, gender (including gender expression and gender identity), pregnancy (including childbirth or related medical conditions, including breastfeeding), military service, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical disability, mental disability, veteran status or any other protected classification under federal, state, or local law. All such decisions are based on (1) individual merit, qualifications, and competence as they relate to the particular position, and (2) promotion of the principle of equal employment opportunity.*

*All other terms and conditions of employment, such as compensation, benefits, transfers, layoff, return from layoff, training, education, and social and recreational programs, are administered without regard to the characteristics described above. To this end, Cumming Group complies with all provisions of Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 as amended, all of the rules, regulations and relevant orders of the Secretary of Labor, and all similar state and local laws.*

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

As a Project Coordinator, you’ll keep projects moving by organizing schedules, records, communications, and day-to-day office tasks. You’ll support project teams and clients with clear follow-through, accurate data entry, and dependable administrative coordination. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys balancing details, people, and priorities in a busy office.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate calendars, meetings, project documents, and follow-up tasks to help teams stay organized.
* Handle front desk duties, multi-line phone systems, phone communication, and customer support with professional phone etiquette.
* Complete data entry, spreadsheets, filing, word processing, and other clerical work using Microsoft Office and productivity software.
* Support office management and client communication while providing responsive customer service.
* Your impact: Accurate coordination and timely communication help project teams stay aligned and give clients a smoother, more reliable experience.

**Qualifications**

* Required: Office experience or related administrative or clerical experience; strong organizational and time management skills; computer literacy, typing, and technical proficiency.
* Required: Clear written and verbal communication, sound phone etiquette, and a customer-focused approach.
* Preferred: QuickBooks experience, personal assistant experience, calendar management, and familiarity with multi-line phone systems.
* Bilingual ability is a plus. Applicants should be comfortable learning and using office software and handling varied administrative tasks.

Pay: $23.00 - $27.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 – 60.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Overview:

MemorialCare is a nonprofit integrated health system that includes four leading hospitals, award-winning medical groups – consisting of over 200 sites of care, and more than 2,000 physicians throughout Orange and Los Angeles Counties. We are committed to increasing access to patient-centric, affordable, and high-quality healthcare; your personal contributions are integral to MemorialCare's recognition as a market leader and innovator in value-based and other care models.

Across our family of medical centers, we support each one of our bright, talented employees in reaching the highest levels of professional development, contribution, collaboration, and accountability. Whatever your role and whatever expertise you bring, we are dedicated to helping you achieve your full potential in an environment of respect, innovation, and teamwork.

Responsibilities:

**Title:** RN Coordinator, Clinical Program - Women's and Newborn Services

**Location:** Long Beach, CA

**Department:** Nursing Administration

**Status:** Full-Time (FT)

**Shift:** Days

**Pay Range:** $62.52/hr - $90.63/hr

MemorialCare is a nonprofit integrated health system that includes four leading hospitals, award-winning medical groups – consisting of over 200 sites of care, and more than 2,000 physicians throughout Orange and Los Angeles Counties. We are committed to increasing access to patient-centric, affordable, and high-quality healthcare; your personal contributions are integral to MemorialCare's recognition as a market leader and innovator in value-based and other care models.

Across our family of medical centers, we support each one of our bright, talented employees in reaching the highest levels of professional development, contribution, collaboration, and accountability. Whatever your role and whatever expertise you bring, we are dedicated to helping you achieve your full potential in an environment of respect, innovation, and teamwork.

**Position Summary**

The Clinical Program Coordinator is responsible for the coordination, implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of clinical programs, quality initiatives, and strategic projects across the Birth Care Center. This position serves as a key resource to operational and physician leaders, providing expertise in performance improvement, program development, data analysis, clinical systems optimization, and multidisciplinary project management. The Clinical Program Coordinator facilitates collaboration among clinical, operational, and medical staff to support safe, high-quality patient care, achieve organizational goals, improve clinical outcomes, and ensure compliance with regulatory and accreditation requirements. The role provides oversight and coordination of assigned clinical programs, supports implementation of service line priorities, and serves as a subject matter expert for quality, safety, performance improvement, and operational excellence initiatives.

**Clinical Program Coordination**  
  
Outcome: Ensures effective coordination and oversight of assigned maternal and newborn clinical programs.  
  
Functions:  
  
Coordinates designated Birth Care Center programs including newborn screening, newborn hearing screening, CCHD screening, HUGS infant security, and other assigned initiatives.  
Serves as a liaison among clinical staff, physicians, ancillary departments, and external agencies.  
Supports program implementation, monitoring, education, and compliance activities.  
Coordinates required audits, reporting, and follow-up activitie

  

**Physician Partnership & Committee Support**  
  
Outcome: Supports physician engagement and interdisciplinary collaboration to advance Birth Care Center priorities.  
  
Functions:  
  
Coordinates Perinatal Morbidity & Mortality conferences and related follow-up activities.  
Represents the Women's Service Line at physician-led committees, workgroups, and service-line meetings.  
Assists with communication, documentation, and implementation of committee recommendations.  
Serves as a resource to physician and operational leaders on assigned programs and projects.

  

**Infant Security Program Coordination (HUGS)**  
  
Outcome: Supports effective administration, monitoring, and continuous improvement of the HUGS Infant Security Program.  
  
Functions:  
  
Serves as the Birth Care Center liaison for the HUGS Infant Security Program.  
Coordinates planned and unplanned HUGS system downtime activities in collaboration with Information Technology, Security, Clinical Engineering, and clinical operations teams.

**Location:** Torrance, CA (race day on site; planning can be partly remote)  
**Pay:** $1,500 flat rate for the event  
**Job type:** Contract, part-time

**About the event**

The Rise Together 5K Run & Walk is a first-year community race on **Sunday, May 23, 2027**, at Charles H. Wilson Park in Torrance. It’s co-hosted by two nonprofits:

* **Mass Liberation** works with empathy and love to address the harms of incarceration, educating and empowering returning citizens through evidence-based, whole-person approaches.
* **New Skin Tattoo Removal** is a 501(c)(3) that provides low-cost tattoo removal to people held back from gainful employment.

Proceeds support reentry services and tattoo removal. The race has a goal of up to 500 runners and walkers, plus a sponsor and resource village where local businesses and reentry service providers will set up booths.

**What you’ll do**

* Build and manage the event timeline from now through race day.
* Coordinate City of Torrance permits with the Special Events & Filming Office and Community Services, plus the event insurance certificate.
* Book and manage vendors: chip timing, race shirts, portable toilets, signage, a sound system, water and post-race food.
* Plan race-day logistics for a loop course: measuring the course, the start/finish area, the water station, lap counting and course marshals.
* Recruit, schedule and brief volunteers.
* Lay out the sponsor and resource village and coordinate booth setup.
* Run race day from setup through teardown, and handle problems as they come up.
* Track the budget and send a short wrap-up report after the event.

**What we’re looking for**

* **Required:** experience coordinating a 5K or other road race, **or** a strong record coordinating community events of 200+ people.
* Experience working with city permits, vendors and insurance requirements.
* Experience recruiting and leading volunteers.
* Organized and dependable, with clear communication and calm problem-solving on event day.
* Available for the full day on Sunday, May 23, 2027, and for setup the day before.
* Reliable transportation to Torrance.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with race registration and timing platforms such as RunSignup.
* Familiarity with South Bay vendors and venues.
* A connection to reentry, workforce or community nonprofit work.

**Compensation**

$1,500 flat rate for the full event, covering planning, race day and wrap-up.

**To apply:** submit your resume along with a short note describing a race or event you coordinated: its size, your role and how it went.

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Torrance, CA 90501

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager / Adoption Strategist
jobs.description:
**About Quilter**
=================

At Quilter, we are helping electrical engineers save time and accomplish more by automating the tedious and time-consuming task of designing printed circuit boards (PCBs). Our small team is composed of experts in electrical engineering, electromagnetic simulation, ML/AI, and high-performance computing (HPC). We are inventing and leveraging novel techniques to solve the decades-old problem of automating circuit board design where today hundreds of billions of dollars are spent. We have raised $25 million in Series B funding from some of the very best and are charging full-speed toward our goal.

No matter where we come from, we're united by a common vision for the future and a core set of values we think will get us there:

* Curiosity
* Conviction
* Rigor

### **About the Role**

This role is a critical, high-impact link between Quilter's AI platform and our enterprise hardware engineering customers. You will serve as both a deep technical expert in workflow integration and a strategic catalyst—driving customer onboarding, tool adoption, expansion, and long-term retention across top-tier enterprise accounts in aerospace, defense, consumer electronics, and robotics. The ideal candidate uncovers blockers to adoption and builds alignment with customer goals to make PCB design more efficient.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* **Drive Adoption & Usage:** Lead recurring weekly customer engagement calls and onboarding programs to guide layout specialists, electrical engineers, and engineering managers through PCB design submission, routing analysis, and workflow integration.
* **Manage Pilots & Expansion:** Shepherd early-stage commercial engagements and paid pilot programs into broad, sustained enterprise deployments across major accounts.
* **Monitor Engagement Metrics:** Track account health and design submission metrics using internal tools like HubSpot and Airtable to proactively identify blockers and scale usage.
* **Technical Support & Diagnostics:** Analyze design failures, Design Rule Check (DRC) flags, and placement/routing bottlenecks on complex boards (e.g., high-speed digital, RF, high-power).
* **Voice of the Customer:** Synthesize customer challenges and edge cases into actionable product requirements for Quilter's engineering teams.

### **Requirements:**

* **Technical Background:** ~7+ years of total professional experience, ideally blending ~2–3 years in hands-on electrical engineering / PCB design and ~4–5 years in customer-facing technical roles.
* **Nice-to-Have ECAD Expertise:** Hands-on familiarity with enterprise ECAD suites—specifically Cadence Allegro or Siemens Xpedition—is highly preferred but not strictly required.
* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
* **Working Location & Travel:** In-office presence 3–4 days per week with 30%+ travel for key customer visits and on-site deployment workshops.
* **Compensation:** $200,000 – $250,000 base salary per year with a 20% – 30% performance bonus structure and equity grant package.

**Please note**: We are an equal opportunity employer. At this time, we are focused on hiring primarily within the US, with occasional exception to accommodate exceptional talent.

**What we offer:**
==================

* Interesting and challenging work
* Competitive salary and equity benefits
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Regular team events and offsites (~4x / year)
* Unlimited paid time off
* Paid parental leave

Want to learn more about Quilter, our vision, and our investors? Visit our About page and visit our Blog.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ABOUT HEAVISIDE INDUSTRIES**

Heaviside Industries builds multi-domain autonomous precision munitions for U.S. and allied special operations and conventional forces. While modern warfare has rapidly evolved with the proliferation of unmanned systems, hyper-precise munitions in contested environments are the future of the battlefield. Economical precision strike capabilities are critical to U.S. and allied war efforts, enabling successful defeat of enemy military assets and infrastructure. Heaviside builds precision munitions designed to operate in GPS-denied and spectrum-jammed battlefields—where traditional systems degrade or fail—without inflated prices or sacrifice to performance.

All engineering and manufacturing is conducted in-house in Heaviside's Los Angeles, CA headquarters and Oslo, Norway office.

Heaviside is backed by Interlagos, Menlo Ventures, Flume Ventures, Cantos, Anorak Ventures, and Ravelin Ventures.

The Role

As Sales Operations Coordinator, you will keep our quoting process accurate and our records clean, so that every order moves smoothly from Business Development to Accounting. You'll prepare and track customer quotes, check incoming purchase orders against what we quoted, and make sure Accounting has complete, organized documentation for invoicing and reconciliation.

This is an early-career role with real responsibility. You'll work closely with our Business Development and Finance teams, correspond directly with customers on quotes and order details, and learn how a fast-growing defense manufacturer turns a customer request into a delivered order.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

**Quoting**

* Prepare price quotes using standard templates, based on input from the Business Development team and company pricing guidelines.
* Revise quotes as customers or BD request changes, and keep version history clear and easy to follow.
* Route quotes for internal review and approval before they go to customers.

**Customer Correspondence**

* Send quotes to customers and serve as a point of contact for questions about pricing, terms, and quote revisions.
* Confirm order details with customers when a purchase order arrives, and follow up on missing or unclear information.
* Keep communication professional, accurate, and timely, and loop in BD when a question needs their input.

**Purchase Orders & Accounting Handoff**

* Check every incoming purchase order (PO) against the quoted price, quantities, and terms, and flag any differences before it moves forward.
* Enter approved POs into our ERP / order management system.
* Package quote, PO, and order documentation for Accounting so invoicing and reconciliation go smoothly.
* Answer Accounting's questions about quotes and orders, and resolve discrepancies with BD and customers.

**Records & Reporting**

* Maintain an organized, audit-ready record of all quotes, revisions, POs, and customer correspondence.
* Track open quotes and pending orders, and share regular status updates with BD and Finance.
* Help improve quoting templates and processes as the business scales.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**
---------------------------

* 0–2 years of experience in sales support, sales operations, customer service, administrative, or accounting support roles. Internships and part-time roles count.
* A bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Exceptional attention to detail. Accuracy in quotes, POs, and records is the heart of this job.
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication, and confidence corresponding directly with customers.
* Comfort with spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets), including basic formulas, sorting, and filtering.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to keep several open quotes and orders on track at once.
* Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and grow with a fast-moving team.
* U.S. Person as defined by ITAR (22 CFR §120.62).

**NICE TO HAVE**
----------------

* Exposure to an ERP or order management system (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Odoo) or a CRM.
* Experience preparing quotes, invoices, or purchase orders.
* Familiarity with basic accounting concepts such as invoicing, accounts receivable, or reconciliation.
* Interest in aerospace, defense, government contracting, or advanced manufacturing.

**Additional Information:**

Compensation bands are determined by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. Individual level and base pay is determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on job-related skills, education, experience, technical capabilities and internal equity. In addition to base salary, for full-time hires, you may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of stock options, and access to medical, vision & dental coverage as well as access to a 401(k) retirement plan.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

SunClean is a growing commercial contract cleaning company serving high-end hotels, luxury multifamily developments, and aerospace facilities. Our work spans the life of a property. We help general contractors prepare new buildings for turnover, and we help property teams care for their windows, façades, floors, and other specialty surfaces once those buildings are in use.

As we expand into Arizona, Nevada, Texas, and Florida, we’re hiring **two Business Development Representatives**. Your focus will be finding and qualifying leads so our Business Development Managers know which opportunities to pursue, who to speak with, and why the timing makes sense.

What You’ll Do

**Specialty cleaning business development.** Connect with hotel general managers, chief engineers, property managers, and facilities teams. Learn how they maintain their properties, which services they outsource, and what work is coming up. A hotel may already have a vendor for its lobby glass and still need help with upper-floor windows, façade cleaning, pressure washing, or carpet and tile cleaning. Your job is to ask the questions that uncover that need.

**Construction business development.** A substantial part of your day will involve researching upcoming and active construction projects and making outbound calls to general contractors, developers, estimators, and project managers. You’ll use project listings, permit records, company websites, etc., to identify promising leads. Through those calls, you’ll confirm what cleaning services the project needs, when the work goes out to bid, and who manages the bid list. You’ll pass qualified leads to our Business Development Managers with the right contact, relevant project details, and bid deadlines.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

* Dedicate a substantial part of each day to prospect research. Review property portfolios, company websites, project listings, and permit records to identify leads for specialty and construction cleaning.
* Make outbound calls and write targeted emails to introduce SunClean, reach the right decision-maker, and learn what work is coming up. Use LinkedIn, networking, and in-person canvassing to develop additional contacts.
* Qualify leads by confirming the service needed, the project timeline, who selects vendors, and any bid requirements or deadlines.
* Manage your lead pipeline in HubSpot. Keep contact details and lead stages current, log calls and emails, and schedule follow-ups around bid dates and vendor reviews.
* Hand qualified leads to Business Development Managers with the details they need to act: who to contact, what the prospect needs, and when to follow up.

What You’ll Bring

You’re comfortable making the first call or introducing yourself in person. You listen closely, ask thoughtful questions, and stay organized enough to follow up at the right time. You enjoy working toward measurable goals and take initiative when you see an opportunity worth pursuing.

**No prior commercial cleaning experience is required.** Experience in sales, customer service, hospitality, property management, or construction is welcome.

Why Join SunClean?

**We look out for each other, and we all want to win.** We share what works, push each other to improve, and celebrate when a teammate hits a goal. If a conversation gets tough, you have people you can talk it through with. If you find an approach that works, you can help the next person get better, too.

As SunClean grows, you’ll have room to grow personally, professionally, and financially. You’ll build confidence speaking with decision-makers, develop the judgment to recognize a real opportunity, and learn to handle rejection without losing momentum. You’ll earn **performance-based bonuses** , with room to take on more responsibility and pursue a path into senior sales, account management, or leadership.

Pay: $3,500.00 - $4,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

**What will you do?**

The primary responsibilities of the Inbound Logistics Coordinator are to proactively monitor, expedite, and measure the import/export flows from sourced vendor freight for their assigned region(s) and brand(s). Accountabilities also include regular meetings with logistics 3PL providers, carriers, as well as with internal business partners within the brands and distribution centers in the assigned region(s).

Let’s break down that day-in-the-life a bit more.

The Inbound Logistics Coordinator will monitor the flow of inbound air, ocean, and truck freight to the distribution network for the assigned region(s). Responsible for ensuring correct carriers are used, dwell time is minimized at various stages of the supply chain, and proactive communication of status of expedited freight to key stakeholders on a regular cadence. Responsible to make sure applicable systems (Infor Nexus, SAP, etc) are updated with relevant dates and milestones as movement of freight occurs within the supply chain. Coordinator will produce and present basic KPIs to measure logistics provider performance and will be accountable to recommend improvements or changes to business process to achieve target lead times and costs.

  

**Logistics Strategy**

* Engage with business partners in developing strategies related to cost, speed, and service.
* Collaborate with logistics team, carriers, and other business partners to develop, design, and implement logistics cost management and customer service enhancement strategies.
* Foster and develop strong relationships with logistics and transportation partners.

* Identify and implement cost savings initiatives.
* Provide internal business partners with air freight estimates and make recommendations for alternative routings when appropriate.
* + Responsible for all lead time analysis, publication, and performance measurements within the responsible brand operations.

* Provide guidance to VF origin logistics team in the case of origin booking and loading exceptions.
* Provide VF distribution centers visibility to inbound volume flow, communicate priority shipments, and expedite deliveries with VF carriers.
* Collaborate with VF business partners and logistics providers to ensure we meet our end of quarter inventory goals.
* Work closely with Customs Compliance team and external customs brokers to optimize the inbound flow.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Project Coordinator

**Company:** Componentry  
**Location:** Fremont, CA — fully onsite  
**Reports to:** President  
**Type:** Full-time, non-exempt, hourly  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m., including a 30-minute unpaid meal break  
**Pay:** $28–$42 per hour, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated skills

About Componentry

Componentry helps hardware companies source and manage materials, build electronic and electromechanical assemblies, and keep production moving. We work as an extension of our customers’ teams, from quoting and procurement through production.

We’re looking for a Project Coordinator to connect the people, information, and actions needed to carry customer jobs from order review through delivery.

The role

You’ll maintain a clear picture of active jobs, follow up on commitments, identify risks, and coordinate solutions so work keeps moving.

Working directly with our President, you’ll partner with procurement, receiving, production, suppliers, and customers. You’ll track what has been purchased, what is outstanding, what is ready to kit or build, and what needs to happen to meet delivery commitments.

You’ll own the shared job dashboard and connect existing purchasing sheets, receiving records, and production schedules. Information should be accessible to the team without someone having to reconstruct a status report whenever an update is needed.

We’re open to training someone with strong organization, initiative, and follow-through. Your independence and decision-making authority will grow as you learn our business and demonstrate sound judgment.

What you’ll ownJob planning and visibility

* Review new orders against quoted lead times, checking material availability and production capacity with the team.
* Establish job milestones and flag conditions that could affect the expected schedule.
* Maintain the shared job dashboard, including purchasing progress, material delivery dates, receiving status, kit readiness, production, inspection, and shipment.
* Connect information across existing records and improve trackers and handoffs where needed.
* Keep blockers, next actions, owners, and deadlines visible.
* Establish regular updates with the team and escalate missing information or unresolved actions that put delivery at risk.
* Maintain traceability between customer jobs, purchase orders, and materials, including purchases supporting multiple jobs.

Follow-through and recovery

* Follow up with procurement on unpurchased items, supplier commitments, outstanding deliveries, and purchasing blockers.
* Follow up with receiving and production on discrepancies, kit completion, build progress, inspection, and rework.
* Identify stalled work, establish the next action with the responsible person, and follow through to resolution.
* Develop recovery plans with procurement and production, using their expertise to evaluate feasible options.
* Coordinate recovery actions and authorize expenses within established limits as responsibility grows.
* Escalate competing customer priorities, unresolved feasibility disagreements, and decisions outside your authority with options and a recommendation.
* Raise risks early enough for the team to respond.

Customer and supplier communication

* Confirm customer requirements, requested dates, and delivery arrangements.
* Obtain supplier shipment commitments, tracking information, and missing documents.
* Communicate job progress, outstanding dependencies, and schedule changes clearly.
* Work with the team and customer to agree on achievable recovery dates within established authority.
* Document commitments and confirm completion through customer delivery.
* Keep the President informed through frequent, concise updates and priority discussions.
* Clearly hand off unresolved issues requiring attention after your workday ends.

Project-related support

* Assist with sourcing, purchasing follow-ups, and documentation needed to move assigned jobs forward.
* Coordinate resolution of supplier account or administrative issues affecting project schedules.

jobs.description:
**Employment Duration:** 6 months

The Research Program Coordinator will serve as a key analyst and coordinator supporting the programmatic and research activities of the Principal Investigator within UCSF’s Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology & Reproductive Sciences.

The position supports multiple grant-funded research projects focused on patient-provider communication, particularly in the areas of pharmacies, sexual and reproductive health, and empathy in healthcare. The Coordinator will conduct moderately complex qualitative and quantitative analytical work, support manuscript preparation and submission, and coordinate research, teaching, and mentorship activities. The research does not involve clinical trials.

The Coordinator will collaborate with UCSF departments, the San Francisco Department of Public Health, research and administrative partners, and outside consultants. The role will also evaluate research processes, data collection and storage practices, and available technologies and services to identify alternatives and make sound recommendations.

The position is within UCSF’s Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology & Reproductive Sciences, a major academic department in the School of Medicine committed to healthcare, education, and research. The role is based within the department’s Zuckerberg San Francisco General division, whose mission includes promoting justice, quality, and equity in women’s healthcare.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct qualitative and quantitative data collection, cleaning, analysis, and other analytical activities supporting multiple research studies focused on patient-provider communication, pharmacies, sexual and reproductive health, and empathy in healthcare.
* Develop and support systems for research data collection, research-subject communication, and confidential data management.
* Prepare, edit, and modify manuscripts, presentations, abstracts, study instruments, research posters, syllabus materials, letters of recommendation, and other research-related documents.
* Conduct professional literature reviews and gather, synthesize, and analyze information to prepare reports and analyses for the Principal Investigator.
* Prepare and present research summaries, reports, and other materials for meetings and internal and external stakeholders.
* Coordinate research, teaching, and mentorship activities, including meetings, conference activities, research activities, grant applications, vendor selection and setup, and joint abstract submissions.
* Coordinate program and project activities with research and project staff and collaborate across UCSF departments and administrative units.
* Interface with partners including the Office of Sponsored Research, Research Administration, and San Francisco Department of Public Health departments as needed.

* Support activities that advance UCSF PRIDE Values and Principles of Community and contribute to an inclusive environment where individuals are treated with dignity and respect.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in any area.
* At least one year of related experience or equivalent training.
* Working knowledge of common organizational or research-specific computer applications, including Microsoft Office, particularly word processing and intermediate Excel functions.

* Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities within demanding timeframes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

For more than 40 years, Hamilton Families has been a leader in the movement to end family homelessness in San Francisco. We believe that every family deserves a safe place to call home and every child deserves the opportunity to thrive. Through our comprehensive programs—including emergency shelter, transitional housing, homelessness prevention, and rapid re-housing—we help families navigate housing crises and achieve long-term housing stability. But we know that housing alone is not enough. Guided by our ambitious Strategic Plan, Hamilton Families is expanding our approach to address the root causes of family homelessness: poverty and systemic inequality. By connecting families to opportunity-rich neighborhoods, centering children's needs, and providing comprehensive support that promotes long-term economic mobility, we're working to ensure that families don't just find housing—they have the resources and opportunities to thrive for generations.

**What You’ll Do**

The Development Team at Hamilton Families is responsible for securing $7–15 million annually and building meaningful partnerships with prominent national and Bay Area philanthropists, corporations, foundations, and community partners to advance our mission. Annual revenue is generated through institutional grants, individual giving, events, corporate partnerships, and other philanthropic investments. In addition, Hamilton Families receives more than $500,000 each year in donated time, goods, materials, and services.

Reporting to the Individual Giving Manager the Coordinator will play an integral role supporting the full Development team and Hamilton Families’ fundraising and community engagement efforts.

This position will support donor stewardship and communications, fundraising operations, prospect research and pipeline development, events and community partnerships, volunteer activations, and in-kind giving. The Coordinator will work closely with colleagues across the Development team to help identify and cultivate new individual and corporate prospects, execute meaningful engagement opportunities, maintain strong fundraising systems and data, and provide flexible support across departmental priorities.

jobs.title: Client Success & Events Manager
jobs.description:
### **About Nowadays**

We're building the future of in-person connection, from intimate exec offsites to conference-level company events.

Nowadays is the AI-native platform for corporate event planning. We combine a 400K+ venue database, automated RFPs, and AI-driven venue outreach with a team that runs events end to end for some of the fastest-growing companies in tech. We're YC-backed, IATA-certified, and book millions in events every year. We move fast and care a lot about the client experience.

### **Who we are**

We're a sister-founded team based in San Francisco. We move fast, care deeply, and love bringing people together (whether it's a strategic offsite or a Friendsgiving in our Nowadays home).

**We believe the best teams:**

* Take ownership
* Keep things scrappy
* Celebrate wins (big and small)
* Genuinely enjoy working (+ hanging out) together

### **What this role is**

As our Client Success & Events Manager, you'll own events end to end for high-profile tech clients, from kickoff to final budget reconciliation, and turn what you learn into automation. You'll sit at the intersection of clients, ops, and our product/engineering team.

Roughly 70% running events and client relationships, 30% building for scale: spotting manual steps in our workflow and partnering with engineering to automate them. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves the craft of a great event and gets equally excited about never doing the same task twice.

### **What you'll do**

**70% of your time will focus on planning and running events**

* Deliver white-glove, end-to-end planning for high-profile tech clients: offsites, retreats, conferences, and dinners for 20 to 2,400+ attendees
* Own pre-planning once the venue is booked: turn the client's vision into a detailed plan and drive it to a flawless event day
* Source and manage vendors across activities, transportation, F&B, AV, branding and signage, gifting, and DMCs, using the Nowadays platform to move fast
* Own the planning deliverables and hit every deadline: workback schedule, weekly client sync + recap, rooming list, transport manifest, run of show, comms calendar, vendor payments (as payer of record), and budget reconciliation
* Be the trusted point of contact for client stakeholders, from executive assistants to people teams to founders
* Lead site visits and travel onsite to make sure events go off without a hitch
* Triage what's urgent vs. what can wait, and keep clients informed without being asked
* Proactively see what needs to happen next and execute it, with no nudging from the client required

**The remaining 30% of your time will focus on turning manual work into automation**

* Map how events actually get done today and find the steps that slow us down
* Write clear requirements and tickets for product/engineering, then test what ships
* Build playbooks, templates, and SOPs that the team can run without you
* Use AI tools to automate repetitive work yourself: vendor follow-ups, client updates, deadline reminders
* Bring client feedback into the product roadmap

### **What we're looking for**

* 3–6 years of corporate event planning experience, ideally at a tech company, startup, agency, or DMC
* You've owned events end to end, including vendor management, budgets, and onsite execution
* Client-obsessed: you're calm under pressure and willing to flex for nights and weekends when an event needs it
* Highly organized with sharp attention to detail: you catch the wrong date in a contract before anyone else
* Clear, warm written communication with clients, vendors, and teammates
* Fast, reliable responsiveness: you reply to clients within hours, not days, and keep threads moving
* Hands-on experience using AI and automation tools (Claude, Zapier, Airtable, or similar) to replace manual work with repeatable processes
* A systems thinker who notices when something is done manually three times and wants to fix it
* Comfortable working in an ambiguous, fast-moving startup environment

**Strongly preferred**

* Events/Hospitality background

**Bonus points**

* Writing tickets in Linear or Jira, or working closely with engineers

### **How you'll operate**

A few of our values that matter most in this role:

* **Unreasonable Hospitality:** Getting the details right is service; how you make people feel is hospitality. You go further than anyone expects to delight our customers, from the first call to the last guest's ride home.
* **Customer's Best Friend:** You listen first and dig into what the client actually needs before reaching for a solution.
* **Extreme Ownership:** You own your events and your clients. You don't wait to be told what to do, and when something goes wrong, you fix it.
* **Growth Mindset:** You try new AI tools before anyone asks, and you're always looking for a better way to do the work.

### **The details**

**Compensation**

$90K–$130K base + 0.2%–0.5% equity (depending on experience)

**Location**

In-person in San Francisco

**Perks**

* Free lunch + dinner in the office
* Quarterly team offsites and access to amazing venues
* Monthly fitness stipend
* Health insurance
* 12 weeks paid parental leave
* 20 days PTO
* Direct access to the founders and real ownership from day one

**How to apply**

Apply through the form on our careers page. Tell us about an event you're proud of, and one process you'd automate if you could.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager (Enterprise)
jobs.description:
**About Browserbase**
---------------------

Browserbase is the complete platform for building and deploying AI agents that browse and interact with the web like humans. With a single API key, developers can enable agents to search and retrieve information, fill out forms, and take action across websites. Today, Browserbase powers more than 50 million browser sessions each month for over 10,000 customers, including Ramp, DeepMind, Clay, Vercel, and Notion.

We're a Series B startup that's tripled our headcount in 2 years, and we're continuing to grow, fast. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, CRV, and Notable Capital, our team is building on our CEO's founding vision to power the world's best AI tools and help everyone automate the web.

**About the role**
------------------

As an Enterprise Technical Customer Success Manager, you’ll own long-term partnerships with customers whose implementations span multiple teams, stakeholders, and business priorities. You’ll help engineering teams build reliable production workflows while ensuring executive sponsors understand the value Browserbase delivers.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can move confidently between debugging an integration, coordinating a complex rollout, and leading an executive conversation about business outcomes. You’ll bring structure to ambiguous situations and maintain accountability from onboarding through renewal and expansion.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Own the post-sale lifecycle for a focused portfolio of enterprise customers, creating joint success plans with measurable outcomes, milestones, owners, and dependencies.
* Lead complex onboarding and adoption programs across engineering, product, and business teams; coordinate security, procurement, and other internal stakeholders when they affect customer progress.
* Read customer code, understand system architecture, and troubleshoot integrations. Guide discussions about reliability, scale, and production readiness in partnership with Engineering.
* Build relationships across technical champions, executive sponsors, and commercial decision-makers so success does not depend on a single contact.
* Run weekly customer meetings with clear agendas, written follow-ups, accountable owners, and reliable closure of commitments. Lead technical workshops, onboarding plans, and escalation reviews as needed.
* Lead QBRs and executive business reviews with senior leaders, connecting adoption and workflow performance to business value and decisions about future investment.
* Own renewal strategy and execution: establish the value case early, manage objections and decision processes, maintain a clear forecast, and close renewals with or without Sales involvement.
* Partner with Sales to develop expansion opportunities across additional teams and use cases, grounded in demonstrated customer needs and outcomes.
* Combine usage, technical performance, stakeholder engagement, and business context to identify risks; lead recovery plans and coordinate escalations through resolution.
* Manage substantial feature-request pipelines: clarify use cases and business impact, advocate for priorities with Product and Engineering, communicate tradeoffs and status, and close the loop without promising uncommitted roadmap work.
* Develop playbooks that strengthen enterprise delivery across the CS team.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* 5+ years in Technical Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, or Technical Account Management, with substantial experience owning enterprise customer relationships. We expect many strong candidates to bring 5–8+ years of relevant experience.
* Experience in a revenue-generating role, with direct accountability for strategic accounts, renewals, and expansion. You can point to commercial outcomes you personally owned.
* Hands-on ability to read and troubleshoot JavaScript/TypeScript or Python, work with APIs and SDKs, interpret logs, and discuss infrastructure and application architecture with engineers.
* Experience coordinating technical implementations across teams, resolving competing priorities, and keeping work moving through dependencies and escalations.
* A track record of stakeholder mapping and multi-threading at large companies, building executive alignment, presenting business value, and guiding difficult commercial or delivery conversations.
* Experience with engineering-heavy customers, earning trust through technical specificity, preparation, and consistent follow-through.
* Strong judgment about when to solve an issue directly and when to bring in Engineering, Product, or commercial partners.
* Clear communication, customer empathy, and the independence to build structure in a fast-moving startup.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience with enterprise developer tools, cloud infrastructure, automation, observability, AI infrastructure, data infrastructure, or security products.
* Experience with browser automation and tools such as Stagehand, Playwright, or Selenium.
* Familiarity with enterprise security reviews, procurement processes, and production reliability requirements.
* Experience mentoring teammates or building enterprise success methodologies.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

Customers launch and sustain reliable production workflows, demonstrate measurable business value, and build durable relationships with Browserbase across their organizations. Renewals are well prepared, risks surface early, and expansion follows successful adoption.

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive salary + meaningful early-stage equity
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents
* 401(k)
* Daily catered lunches with a fully-stocked kitchen
* Beautiful office in downtown San Francisco
* All the AI tools + credits you want
* Regular team offsites and company events

OTE (includes base + commission)

$211,500 - $264,5

jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Business Partner to the CEO
jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant & Business Partner to the CEO — (San Francisco, CA)**

**Full-time | In-person | 5+ years of relevant experience required**

**FurtherAI** is building the AI Workspace for Insurance, empowering underwriters, brokers, and carriers to automate routine work so they can focus on higher-value decisions. We move fast, prioritize clarity and quality, and value effective, high-integrity work.

**The role**
------------

This is not a traditional EA job. You'll be the CEO's right hand: part Executive Assistant, part Executive Business Partner, and the owner of how it feels to work at FurtherAI day to day.

You'll own the CEO's time, priorities, and follow-through end to end, so the most important work keeps moving and nothing falls between conversations. You'll also build the workplace experience from the ground up: our office, our rituals, our offsites, and the small details that make a fast-growing team feel like a team.

The best person for this role acts as a force multiplier. You anticipate needs before they're voiced, reduce the CEO's cognitive load, and bring the judgment to decide what deserves attention and what doesn't. As we scale, this role grows with you.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Run the CEO's time and attention**

* Own the CEO's calendar end to end: sequence priorities, protect focus time, anticipate conflicts, and decide what truly needs their time.
* Triage the CEO's inbox, surface what matters, and draft clear, thoughtful replies on their behalf.
* Coordinate complex scheduling across customers, investors, candidates, press, and the internal team.
* Plan travel and logistics end to end, with the right prep and follow-through built in.
* Handle occasional personal logistics (appointments, vendors, travel) with discretion and sound judgment.

### **Be a true business partner**

* Make sure the CEO walks into every key meeting prepared: agendas, pre-reads, context, and who's in the room.
* Capture decisions and action items, then drive follow-through so nothing important gets lost.
* Build and run a lightweight operating system for priorities, open loops, and commitments.
* Own logistics and prep for board meetings, investor updates, and leadership syncs.
* Take on special projects with the CEO and leadership team: research, process improvements, and cross-functional initiatives.

### **Own the workplace experience**

* Run the San Francisco office: space, vendors, supplies, food, and making sure it works for the team every day.
* Plan team offsites, all-hands, celebrations, and customer or candidate events.
* Partner with Recruiting and People on onboarding, so every new hire feels welcome and productive from day one.
* Shape and scale our culture through rituals, engagement initiatives, and internal communications.
* Build the processes and documentation that help the office and team run smoothly as we grow across locations.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* **First 30 days:** You know the CEO's priorities, working style, and key relationships. Their calendar and inbox run smoothly, and you've got a handle on how the office runs today.
* **First 90 days:** You're trusted to make calls on the CEO's behalf. You've built the operating rhythm for meeting prep and follow-through, and you've run your first offsite or company event.
* **First year:** The CEO spends more of their time on the highest-impact work because of you. The workplace experience is something candidates notice and the team is proud of.

**About you**
-------------

* 5 to 8+ years supporting a founder, CEO, or C-suite leader, ideally at a fast-growing startup.
* Experience owning office or workplace operations, events, or team culture programs.
* Excellent judgment and discretion, with a track record of handling confidential information.
* Highly organized and detail-oriented without losing speed. You build structure where there is none.
* A clear, warm communicator who adapts to different styles and builds trust across every team.
* You anticipate needs, spot issues early, and fix them without being asked.
* Calm and effective in a high-stakes, fast-changing environment.
* Fluent in modern tools: Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, and AI assistants like Claude or ChatGPT.
* Based in San Francisco and excited to be in the office 5 days a week.
* Bonus: experience at an AI or B2B SaaS company.

### **This role is not for you if**

* You prefer a rigid, predictable, or slow-moving environment.
* You want to manage rather than roll up your sleeves and do.
* You're not excited about high ownership and hands-on execution.
* You can't work in person in San Francisco.
* Work/life balance is important to you

**Why Join FurtherAI:**

* Partner closely with founders/leadership at a fast-growing AI company
* Gain exposure and responsibility across all aspects of early-stage operations
* Help shape culture and foundational processes
* Receive competitive salary, equity, and benefits
* Join a team that values speed, communication, and craftsmanship

**You can look forward to the following benefits:**

* Fully covered, best-in-class health, dental, and vision benefits
* Competitive Compensation, meaningful stock options, company 401(k)
* Unlimited PTO
* Outstanding in-office culture in the heart of San Francisco
* Lunch and dinner onsite
* Team events, such as happy hours and off-sites
* Commuter benefits

Compensation Range: $140K - $165K

**Sales Development Representative (SDR)**
==========================================

*In Office · San Francisco or Montreal · Full-time*

**ABOUT SARIS**
---------------

We're a San Francisco and Montreal-based applied AI startup building the future of work in the banking industry. We're tackling a $100 billion-per-year problem, doubling every quarter, and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with multi-turn agentic AI systems.

We've shipped real AI agents that handle customer workflows in production for banks and credit unions. With a growing customer base and live deployments, we're scaling fast and looking for driven people who want to make an outsized impact early.

**THE ROLE**
------------

We're looking for a hungry, competitive Sales Development Representative to help us build pipeline across banks and credit unions.

You'll be leading initial conversations with financial institutions. Your goal will be to identify prospects that fit our ideal customer profile (ICP), understand their pain points, and book qualified meetings for our Account Executives.

You'll work closely with sales leadership and marketing, and you'll be on the ground at industry conferences. This is a high-visibility role on a small team, with a clear path to closing deals yourself.

**YOUR MISSION IS TO**
----------------------

* Build pipeline by prospecting into banks and credit unions, targeting mortgage, lending, operations, and executive leaders through calls, email, LinkedIn, and events.
* Identify prospects that fit our ICP, uncover operational pain points, and book qualified discovery meetings for Account Executives.
* Capture key qualification details, including team size, loan volume, current challenges, decision-makers, and next steps.
* Attend industry conferences: research attendees beforehand, conduct outreach through event apps, work the booth, and follow up quickly after each event.
* Partner with marketing on campaigns, event strategy, messaging, and targeted outreach, sharing insights from conversations with prospects.
* Track every touchpoint, meeting, and next step in our CRM to maintain accurate pipeline visibility.
* Hit weekly and monthly activity and qualified meeting targets, and share what's working with the team.
* Develop a strong understanding of our product and banking operations to have credible conversations with senior financial institution leaders.

**WHO YOU ARE**
---------------

* Hungry, coachable, and competitive. You want to win and aren't afraid of rejection.
* Ideally have at least one year of SDR/BDR or other outbound sales experience, but it's not required. If you've demonstrated grit elsewhere (sales, athletics, service, or a startup), we want to hear from you.
* A strong communicator in writing and on the phone, comfortable engaging with executives.
* Organized and disciplined about follow-up and CRM hygiene.
* Comfortable traveling to industry conferences and events.
* **Based in or near San Francisco or Montreal.**
* Curious about AI and how it's transforming financial services.

**BONUS POINTS IF YOU**
-----------------------

* Have sold to banks, credit unions, or mortgage teams, or worked within a financial institution.
* Have experience with SaaS or AI products.
* Have worked trade shows or industry conferences.
* Are familiar with CRM and sales engagement tools.

**COMPENSATION**
----------------

**San Francisco**

* Base Salary: 65,000–80,000 USD
* On-Target Earnings (OTE): 95,000–115,000 USD
* Equity included

**Montreal**

* Base Salary: CAD 55,000–80,000
* On-Target Earnings (OTE): CAD 95,000–115,000
* Equity included

Commission is uncapped and tied to qualified meetings and pipeline created.

**WHY JOIN SARIS?**
-------------------

* Help build the future of work for the trillion-dollar banking industry using cutting-edge AI technology.
* Clear opportunity to grow from SDR into an Account Executive role on a fast-growing team.
* Competitive base salary, uncapped commission, premium benefits, and equity.
* Work alongside talented engineers, builders, and leaders, including repeat YC founders with a successful exit (Ready Education).
* Join a company with production AI agents already delivering value to revenue-generating customers.
* Be part of a team backed by Tier 1 Silicon Valley venture capital firms.

The New York City Mayor’s Office is responsible for overseeing city services throughout the five boroughs, coordinating public agencies and departments, and managing public property. **Job Description**
-------------------

To be considered for this position candidate must be serving permanently or be reachable on the civil service list.
  
  
The New York City Department of Transportation (DOT) Office of Construction Mitigation and Coordination (OCMC)-Streets is tasked with coordinating all construction activity occurring within the City’s roadways and sidewalks as well as reviewing all construction permit applications and developing traffic stipulations. Our primary goal is to allow construction activity to occur with minimal disruption to businesses, motorists, bicyclists, and pedestrians, while avoiding conflicts with special events and other construction projects. OCMC-Streets interacts with project engineers, other city agencies, community boards, elected officials, and the general public to resolve construction issues related to mobility.
  
  
OCMC-Streets is seeking an ambitious and motivated individual to join our team as Project Coordinator. Under the supervision of the Director of OCMC-Streets, the candidate will act directly as the long-term manager of a specific geographical area within the five boroughs to which they will be assigned, and for which they will be responsible reviewing construction plans for both private and governmental contract work; collecting necessary data and information for the purpose of developing traffic stipulations for incorporation into governmental contracts; reviewing construction permit applications for the purpose of issuing traffic stipulations on construction activity permits; organizing, chairing and attending coordination meetings related to building construction activity occurring on the city’s roadways and sidewalks; conducting in-depth field investigations to develop necessary traffic detours related to construction; and following up with other NYC DOT units, other agencies, contractors and expediters as necessary to ensure construction is occurring according to permit requirements, and community concerns are being addressed. When needed, the candidate will make recommendations for alternative methods of performing construction in order to reduce the impact upon the public. The candidate will also be responsible for investigating complaints received from the public, elected officials, and other agencies, related to construction activity within their geographical review area, and preparing written responses based on obtained permit data and/or information gathered during site visits, and determining any further action to be taken.
  
  
TRANSPORTATION SPECIALIST - 22316

  
  

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

  
  

1. A master's degree in transportation engineering, mathematics, urban planning, architecture, landscape architecture, urban studies, or related physical and social science fields; or
  
  
2. A baccalaureate degree in engineering from an accredited college and one year of full-time satisfactory experience performing technical work on roadway transportation and traffic studies and area-wide traffic programs; or
  
  
3. A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and two years of full-time satisfactory experience as described in "2" above; or
  
  
4. An associate degree or completion of 60 semester credits from an accredited college and four years of full-time satisfactory experience as described in "2" above; or
  
  
5. A four-year high school diploma or its educational equivalent and six years of full-time satisfactory experience as described in "2" above.
  
  
SPECIAL NOTE:
  
  
In addition to meeting the minimum Qualification Requirements above:
  
  
To be assigned to Assignment Level II, the candidate must have an additional year of experience as described in the "Qualification Requirements" listed under "2" above.
  
  
To be assigned to Assignment Level III, the candidate must have an additional two years of experience as described in the "Qualification Requirements" listed under "2" above.

  
  

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

  
Preference will be given to candidate who possess a driver’s license valid in the State of New York with no restrictions. This license must be maintained throughout duration of employment in this position. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Ability to meet deadlines and work on multiple tasks simultaneously. Excellent written and oral communication skills, as well as strong interpersonal skills. Ability to review documents for accuracy, identify problems, manage against tight timelines, and prioritize projects. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook. Knowledge of CCU/ARTS and NYC Streets is a plus.
  

**55a Program**
---------------

  
This position is also open to qualified persons with a disability who are eligible for the 55-a Program. Please indicate at the top of your resume and cover letter that you would like to be considered for the position through the 55-a Program.
  

**Public Service Loan Forgiveness**
-----------------------------------

  
As a prospective employee of the City of New York, you may be eligible for federal loan forgiveness programs and state repayment assistance programs. For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s website at https://studentaid.gov/pslf/.
  

**Residency Requirement**
-------------------------

  
New York City residency is generally required within 90 days of appointment. However, City Employees in certain titles who have worked for the City for 2 continuous years may also be eligible to reside in Nassau, Suffolk, Putnam, Westchester, Rockland, or Orange County. To determine if the residency requirement applies to you, please discuss with the agency representative at the time of interview.

Who We Are
  
The Fund for Public Health in New York City (FPHNYC) is a 501(c)3 non-profit organization that is dedicated to the advancement of the health and well-being of all New Yorkers. To this end, in partnership with the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH), FPHNYC incubates innovative public health initiatives implemented by DOHMH to advance community health throughout the city. It facilitates partnerships, often new and unconventional, between government and the private sector to develop, test, and launch new initiatives. These collaborations speed the execution of demonstration projects, effect expansion of successful pilot programs, and support rapid implementation to meet the public health needs of individuals, families, and communities across New York City.
  
  
Our Culture
  
We embrace a culture of learning, collaboration, innovation, and well-being, where open communication drives our impact.
  
About The Role
  
The Program Coordinator will support the day-to-day implementation of the Nest and Nourish program, a HRSA-funded prescription produce program for pregnant and postpartum individuals. The position will serve as a primary point of contact for participants, including coordinating enrollment, navigation, referrals, follow-up, data collection, and retention activities. The coordinator will work closely with clinical partners, community-based organizations, program staff, and program leadership to ensure effective implementation of the program.
  
About the Program
  
Nest & Nourish is a program of the NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene’s Bureau of Brooklyn Neighborhood Health that aims to improve maternal health by increasing food access and security among pregnant and postpartum participants. The program provides produce benefits, nutrition education, case management, and connections to community resources. This program is one of several food access initiatives in the Bureau of Brooklyn Neighborhood Health.
  
  
Responsibilities
  

* Coordinate participant recruitment, eligibility screening, enrollment, and orientation to services.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for participants during program engagement.
* Conduct regular participants check-ins and assess food access, social needs, and barriers to participation.
* Coordinate distribution and tracking of monthly benefits.
* Monitor participant engagement, voucher redemption, nutrition education participation, and retention. Provide referrals and navigation assistance to other bureau programs and community resource activities.
* Coordinate required nutrition education classes, cooking demonstrations, and other program activities.
* Conduct reminder and re-engagement outreach for participants who miss appointments or program activities.
* Maintain accurate and timely participant records in accordance with program and privacy requirements.
* Collect survey data and other program evaluation data and support monitoring of data quality.
* Support program outreach, community engagement, and recruitment events.
* Prepare routine program updates and identify participants’ needs, barriers, and opportunities for improvement.
* Support grant deliverables, reporting, and program implantation activities.

Requirements
  

* A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and two years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties described above; or
* High school graduation or equivalent and six years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties as described above; or
* Education and/or experience which is equivalent to "1" or "2" above. However, all candidates must have at least one year of experience as described in "1" above.
* Strong attention to detail and consistent follow-through.
* Excellent organizational skills and highly detailed oriented
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Demonstrated ability to effectively establish and maintain working relationships with culturally diverse community groups.
* Bilingual (written and spoken) Spanish language proficiency preferred.
* Physical Requirements: Ability to stand for extended periods of time. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check
  
  
**Benefits/ Additional Information:**  

* Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) eligible employer
* Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) policy
* Medical, dental, and life insurance with low or no employee contribution
* A retirement savings plan with generous employer contribution

Lenox Advisors brings together sophisticated solutions in wealth management and insurance services to high-net-worth individuals and their families. As a wholly owned subsidiary of NFP Corp., an Aon Company, we combine the culture of a boutique firm with the stability and backing of a large corporation to create an environment that's truly unique. * **Professional Experience:** Minimum of 1–2 years of experience in a formal sales or business development environment.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Prior experience navigating CRM platforms (Salesforce/HubSpot) is highly preferred.
* **Industry Knowledge:** Background in physical/virtual events, hospitality, commercial real estate, or flexible workspace solutions is considered a significant asset.
* **Competencies:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; ability to navigate complex client inquiries with poise; and a demonstrated capacity for multitasking in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.

* + Reports to the Senior Manager, Learning & Outreach

* Full-time position, 40 hours per week.
* Payrate $21.17 an hour, $44,033.60
