jobs.title: Account Manager- Skills Intelligence
jobs.description:
**Description**

Vector Solutions is a leading software company delivering an AI-enabled, performance platform powering safe, compliant, and efficient operations for the public, educational, and commercial sectors. We bring training, safety, and workforce operations together to boost readiness, reduce risk, and drive high-performance results for the everyday heroes who count on us.

Skills Intelligence is a new AI-native software product Vector brought to market in Q4-2026 for industrial manufacturing companies, and this role owns the post-sales experience for it. You'll own the full customer journey, from implementation through adoption and, ultimately, renewal. That starts with getting brand-new and existing Vector customers live and seeing value fast, then building the relationships with each customer and results that keep them renewing and growing with us.

This is an exciting opportunity to help launch and shape a brand-new product line and service inside an established, well-resourced company. You'll get to help craft the customer playbook from the ground up, partnering closely with Sales, Product, and leadership and working in a best-in-class, AI-native product.

As the Technical Account Manager for Skills Intelligence, you'll own every customer's journey, from the moment a deal closes through go-live, adoption, expansion, and renewal. You'll lead implementations, turn new users into engaged ones, and own the renewal for every account in your book, building the trust and results that keep customers growing with Vector year after year. Because Skills Intelligence is brand new, you'll also help build the playbook every future Skills Intelligence customer runs on.

**What You’ll Do**

**Lead Skills Implementations**

* Own each implementation from sales handoff through go-live, including kickoff, configuration, data setup, and training. Note this system was built with an AI-ingestion tool that will do most of the heavy technical lifting, but you will make sure this output meets the customer’s vision
* Learn each customer's business processes and goals, then build an implementation plan with clear timelines, owners, and next steps.
* Run regular status meetings, give strategic advice when needs fall outside the product or the contract, and keep projects on track.
* Partner with Sales during handoff to capture customer goals, success criteria, and any commitments made during the sales process.
* Coordinate with Product, Support, and technical teams to resolve configuration issues and clear roadblocks quickly.

**Drive Adoption and Value**

* Act as the primary point of contact after go-live, handling support questions and escalations.
* Track usage and adoption, and step in with targeted training or enablement when engagement drops.
* Lead regular business reviews that tie Skills usage back to each customer's goals and measurable outcomes.
* Monitor account health, flag risks early, and step in with a plan before small issues become renewal risks.

**Own Renewals and Growth**

* Own the renewal for every account in your book, from forecasting and risk mitigation through negotiation and signature.
* Get ahead of retention with weekly, high-touch check-ins. With renewals still a year out, this is your chance to build real relationships and set customers up to renew with confidence next year.
* Spot expansion opportunities and partner with Sales to grow accounts.
* Keep Salesforce current with account health, renewal forecasts, and expansion pipeline.

**Partner with the Team (Ronda, Joey, Kenny) to Build the Skills Playbook**

* Define the implementation of methodology, onboarding resources, and training materials for Skills Intelligence.
* Serve as an early voice of the customer, sharing product feedback and market signal to help shape the roadmap.
* Document best practices and repeatable processes as you go so the Skills team can scale.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Requirements**

* 3-5 years in software implementation, technical account management, onboarding, or customer success, ideally in B2B SaaS.
* Familiarity with industrial manufacturing space is preferred.
* Proven track record of leading implementations with multiple stakeholders from kickoff to go-live.
* Experience owning renewals and retention for a book of business.
* Strong technical aptitude: comfortable with software configuration, data setup, and troubleshooting, and quick to learn new platforms.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple customers at once.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to senior leaders.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and excited to build processes for a new product.
* Proficient in Salesforce and Microsoft Office, with genuine interest in AI tools.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred.

**What You Can Expect From Us:**

* Friendly, open, and casual work environment
* Comprehensive benefits package effective the first of the month after hire
* Matching 401(k) retirement plan
* Healthy work-life balance with flexible work arrangements and generous time off
* Generous referral incentive program
* Tuition Reimbursement Program
* Pet Insurance
* OnePass Gym/Wellness Discount Program
* Calm Health-Employee Membership
* Company social events
* Employee Resource Groups
* Philanthropic opportunities

**What We Value:**

* **Teamwork** - Above all, we’re a team. We give and value feedback. We support each other, respect each other and work together to accomplish our common goals and serve our customers. Once we make decisions, we align behind them as a team.
* **Customers First** - Our customers’ success is our success. They are why we are here. We work to earn the trust of our customers and always deliver on our commitments.
* **Make a Difference** - It’s not a job, it’s a calling. We have passion for our mission, for our customers, for our work, and for sharing a fulfilling experience with our fellow team members.

**What You’ll Bring**
=====================

* **Experience:** 3–5 years in Customer Success, Onboarding, Implementation, or a similar customer-facing role, ideally in SaaS or healthcare technology.

* **Collaboration:** A team player who builds rapport easily and brings others along to get things done.
* **Project Management:** Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to juggle multiple projects and competing priorities without dropping details.
* **Excellent Communication:** Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly and effectively.

**Why Passage Health?**

* Outsized impact—as an early employee, your work will shape both the company and our users’ experience.

* A fast-paced environment full of substantive challenges.
* Competitive salary and equity.

The Associate Manager, Global Marketing Communications will support the growth of Fresh market share worldwide by helping develop and execute global and localized marketing campaign plans. They will report to and partner closely with the Director, Global Marketing Communications to build the Global Go-To-Market Strategy for all categories across the business. This person will work with global and international partners to help bring marketing activations to life, supporting the balance between long term strategic thinking and short-term tactical execution across media plans, content strategy, and retail activations.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
*The New Israel Fund (NIF) is the leading organization defending democracy and equality in Israel. NIF supports initiatives that strengthen the country’s democratic institutions, defend basic freedoms and human rights, promote equality, and build a truly shared society in Israel. Read more about NIF* *here**.*

  

**POSITION TITLE**: Social Media Manager
  
**LOCATION**: New York City area strongly preferred; remote applicants considered
  
*New York City-based employees work a hybrid schedule of in-person and at-home days; office is located near Penn Station in Manhattan*  
**STATUS**: Full-time, exempt
  
*This position is included in a union-represented collective bargaining unit*  
**COMPENSATION**: $75,000 – $85,000 annually; comprehensive benefits package (details below)
  
**APPLICATION DEADLINE**: December 6, 2026

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The New Israel Fund is looking for a creative, strategic, and very online Social Media Manager to join our Public Engagement team and lead NIF’s presence across social platforms.

We’re looking for someone who understands what makes great content—and has the skills to create it. You should be an excellent writer, sharp editor, creative thinker, and hands-on content creator with strong instincts for turning complicated ideas, breaking news, powerful stories, and NIF’s work into content people want to watch, read, share, and act on.

You’ll work closely with our Visual Content Manager, sharing responsibility for designing, filming, and editing social content, and report to our Deputy VP, Marketing & Communications.

This role requires someone who can see both the forest and the trees: someone who can obsess over the first three seconds of a reel or the wording of an Instagram carousel while also understanding the larger story we’re trying to tell about Israelis, Palestinians, democracy, equality, human rights, and the people fighting for change.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Lead NIF’s social media presence and help shape our broader social strategy** across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, and emerging platforms.
* **Create compelling social content from idea to execution**, including concepts, hooks, scripts, Reels, carousels, graphics, captions, and Stories. Personally design and edit content while working closely with the Visual Content Manager on shared production.
* **Find and tell the story.** Turn breaking news, complicated issues, updates from NIF partners, and events on the ground into clear, accessible content. Proactively surface the people, moments, footage, and ideas that can bring those stories to life.
* **Serve as NIF’s eyes and ears online.** Stay plugged into news, social trends, creators, and conversations; identify opportunities for timely content and rapid response; and know when a trend is worth pursuing and when it isn’t.
* **Grow and engage NIF’s audience**, leveraging social content to support broader team goals.
* **Test, learn, and improve.** Use performance data to understand what works and continuously refine our content, creative approaches, and social strategy.
* **Collaborate across NIF** and with activists, partners, creators, and other voices to develop and amplify compelling content.
  

**REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

* 3-5 years of experience managing social media accounts for a nonprofit, brand, media organization, public figure or personality, campaign, or similar organization.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent social content and a clear understanding of what works across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, and other platforms.
* Exceptional written and oral communication skills, with excellent editorial judgment and the ability to make complicated subjects clear, compelling, and accessible.
* Strong hands-on content creation skills, including some graphic design and short-form video editing, with the ability to independently take a social post from concept through publication.
* Strong creative instincts for hooks, storytelling, visuals, and pacing, as well as the ability to collaborate closely with another creative to develop and execute more ambitious content.
* Ability to see the big picture while sweating the details, balancing strategy with hands-on content creation and planned work with rapid response.
* Strong news judgment, organizational skills, and the ability to work quickly, calmly, and collaboratively in a fast-moving environment.
* Fluency with publishing and analytics tools and the ability to use performance data to make creative decisions.
* Familiarity with NIF’s work or Israeli and Palestinian politics, or a demonstrated ability to quickly become fluent in complex subject matter.
* Alignment with NIF’s mission and values.
  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**  
*The following qualifications are not required, but are a plus.*

* Experience creating social content about politics, advocacy, human rights, international affairs, or other complex and fast-moving issues.
* Experience with paid social, audience acquisition, and/or fundraising creative.
* Experience successfully growing social audiences.
* Experience with and openness to leveraging AI tools to produce or edit written content in support of social media marketing.
* Experience working with creators, influencers, activists, or other external voices to develop content.
* Comfort appearing on camera and/or directing and coaching others for social video.
* Experience working in a newsroom, campaign, movement, or other rapid-response environment.
* Hebrew and/or Arabic proficiency.
  

**SALARY AND BENEFITS:**

The salary range for this position is $75,000 – $85,000 annually commensurate with experience, qualification and skills.

NIF offers a generous benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, and life insurance; short-term and long-term disability; paid parental leave for birth or adoptive parent and spouse; flex spending; retirement contribution; vacation, sick leave, personal days, and paid holidays

**WHY UJA, WHY NOW?**

Big problems need big solutions. And for more than a century, UJA-Federation of New York has been at the center of Jewish New York, bringing people and partners together to meet challenges no single organization can solve alone.

Today, these challenges are more urgent than ever: rising antisemitism, the enduring impact of October 7 on Israeli society, and the rising cost of living right here at home. At the same time, we’re seeing something new and powerful: Jewish community members yearning to connect, to show up proudly Jewish, and to be part of something larger than themselves.

At this moment, UJA’s role has never been more important. And how we tell our story matters: building awareness of our work, deepening engagement, and helping people feel connected to a community they want to be part of.

If this sounds like work you’d love to do, we hope you’ll apply.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

You know that a social feed is more than a collection of posts. It’s a place where people start conversations, build community, respond in real time, and keep coming back for more. And it’s one of the most visible ways UJA shows up in the world.

As UJA’s Social Media Manager, you’ll shape what that looks like—and help make UJA a must-follow voice in the Jewish community. You’ll lead the strategy and day-to-day work, find fresh ways to tell our story, and elevate the voices of our leadership, partners, and the people behind our work.

You’ll also lead our influencer partnerships, connecting with creators and leading voices in the Jewish community to reach new audiences. And you’ll manage and mentor our Social Media Associate while collaborating with colleagues across UJA.

The work moves fast, the news doesn’t wait, and no two days look the same. You’re unflappable and ready for all of it.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Lead UJA’s social media strategy and oversee its execution across our platforms.

* Develop organic social strategies for major events, working with speakers, influencers, donors, fundraisers, and other partners.
* Partner with content, video, email, and design colleagues to create more compelling, platform-appropriate content—and give good stories a longer life across channels.
* Stay on top of emerging platforms, trends, and best practices, and test new approaches that make sense for UJA.

**Lead a team and build strong partnerships**

* Manage and mentor the Social Media Associate and interns, providing direction, feedback, and oversight of day-to-day work and community engagement.

* Contribute to an integrated digital content strategy across social, web, and email.
* Develop stories, articles, visuals, and campaign assets using interviews and internal and external sources.
* Maintain an editorial calendar for UJA’s social channels and identify opportunities to bring UJA’s work to life.
* Help connect content to broader goals, including audience engagement, lead generation, and user journeys.

**Build influencer partnerships**

* Identify and build relationships with influencers, creators, and leading voices who can introduce UJA to new audiences and deepen engagement with our work.
* Shape paid and organic influencer collaborations, guide the creative, and oversee the Social Media Associate’s work on logistics and administration.

**Know when—and how—to respond**

* Monitor social conversations, relevant news, and UJA’s online reputation.
* Identify and escalate emerging issues, bringing good judgment and a clear sense of urgency.
* Work with PR and marketing leadership to develop and coordinate social responses during sensitive or fast-moving moments.

**WHO YOU ARE**

You have your finger on the pulse of cultural conversations, both inside and outside the Jewish world. You’re as comfortable shaping a social strategy as you are getting a post out the door, from design to copy. You think in words *and* pictures, know the ins and outs of each platform, and have the judgment to know when—and how—to join the conversation.

You’re a savvy, diplomatic relationship-builder and team player who works well with all kinds of people, from creative teams and fundraisers to senior leadership and external partners. You thrive under pressure and are a master juggler.

**You bring:**

* 5–10 years of marketing experience, with demonstrated results in campaign strategy and execution.
* Experience managing campaigns across major social platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, and Threads.

These woven coverings for tabletops, floors, walls, windows, furnishings, and more are made in the United States, and the design-driven company operates its own factory in Chatsworth, Georgia. The coordinator supports the day-to-day operations of the Technology Services team by managing vendor bills and invoices, keeping the helpdesk queue moving, and coordinating IT staffing, meetings, and project tasks. **Helpdesk Reporting**

Requirements

Knowledge Skills, and Abilities

* Familiar with using Claude. The role will use Claude to do much of this work

* Pay rate of $32.38 per hour
* Commuter benefits - parking and mass transit
* Admission to world-renowned museums across the city and nationally

*If you believe that you could excel in this role, we encourage you to apply. We are dedicated to considering a broad array of candidates. **About the Whitney**  
The Whitney Museum of American Art, founded in 1930 by the artist and philanthropist Gertrude Vanderbilt Whitney, houses the foremost collection of American art from the twentieth and twenty-first centuries. Campari Group today is a major player in the global branded spirits industry, with a portfolio of over 50 premium and super premium brands, marketed and distributed in over 190 markets around the world, with leading positions in Europe and the Americas.

Research Assistant

Non-exempt

**CAMPUS SPECIFIC INFORMATION**

The Borough of Manhattan Community College (BMCC) is a vibrant, pluralistic learning community committed to students’ intellectual and personal growth. The College bridges the economic and educational opportunity gap for students, more than half of whom are the first in their families to attend college. Working to strengthen a culture of care inside and outside the classroom, we share a passion for learning with students from around the world. Strategically located in downtown Manhattan, the College is in close proximity to the artistic communities of Tribeca and SoHo, the dynamic downtown financial district, and the center of New York City government at City Hall. BMCC prides itself on the diversity of our students. We are an inclusive community that promotes an atmosphere of mutual respect for each member’s ethnicity, gender, age, disability, religion, political preference, sexual orientation, gender identity, and national origin, among other personal characteristics. BMCC’s motto speaks to this shared sense of purpose and possibility: Start Here, Go Anywhere. We strive to increase degree completion, successful transfer, career achievement, and service and leadership within our community, New York City, and beyond.

The Office of Research at Borough of Manhattan Community College (BMCC) supports and advances a vibrant culture of inquiry, innovation, and scholarly excellence, empowering students to reach their full academic and professional potential. We oversee and coordinate a wide range of research and educational programs, including faculty and student research initiatives, compliance with research regulations, grant development support, and STEM enrichment programs for high school and college students. Through inclusive and equitable access to research opportunities, we foster student growth, critical thinking, and hands-on learning that prepare them for future careers and advanced study. Our office is dedicated to supporting faculty, staff, and students in their pursuit of impactful research that not only contributes to scientific knowledge and community well-being but also enhances student success, achievement, and leadership.

In addition to the general duties, the responsibilities of the position include, but are not limited to the following:

* Management of the Wet Laboratory, Cell Culture Laboratory, Physics/Engineering Laboratory, Physics/Engineering Laboratory, Computer Laboratory, and the Social Sciences Research Laboratory.
* Assists with preventative maintenance and repairs of lab equipment as needed.
* Adheres to safety and hygiene standards and ethical conduct as defined by the University and relevant

outside parties, ensures a clean working area and is responsible for washing and storing glassware.

* Assists in maintaining inventory of supplies, equipment, and/or reagents, and ordering

supplies/equipment/reagents as authorized or ensuring that needs are escalated appropriately.

* Reviews and implements standard operating procedures (SOPs) and policies for all Office of Research

facilities.

* Enforces policies and schedules to ensure fair utilization of equipment by research assistants and faculty

conducting research activities.

* Maintains Core laboratory supplies inventory by checking stock to determine inventory level, anticipating

needed supplies; placing and expediting orders for supplies; verifying receipt of supplies.

* Helps plan all Office of Research events and assists with student research projects when needed.
* Provides technical guidance and instruction to students when faculty mentors are not available.
* Verifies that all students and research assistants complete specific CITI certifications pertaining to their

research.

* Supports students and research assistants with facility-specific orientations regarding safety procedures,

policies, supply placement, and general research procedures.

* Approves and inputs Office of Research facilities reservations into the BMCC Research Core calendar.
* Manage daily activities with coordination and communication among faculty, directors, and other

laboratory personnel.

* Assists Department Administrator as needed.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience relevant to the research being performed.

**OTHER QUALIFICATIONS**

* Previous research and teaching/student-related experience.
* High level of organizational skills, presenting technical information; equipment maintenance; training; quality focus; and technical knowledge in STEM field.

**COMPENSATION**

Salary range is $48,710 - $66,120, Salary commensurate with education and experience.

CUNY offers a comprehensive benefits package to employees and eligible dependents based on job title and classification. Employees are also offered pension and Tax-Deferred Savings Plans. Part-time employees must meet a weekly or semester work hour criteria to be eligible for health benefits. Health benefits are also extended to retirees who meet the eligibility criteria.

1. Knowledge of aquatic program planning, instruction, and delivery.
  
2. Knowledge of athletics and sports program administration, rules, and best practices.
  
3. Knowledge of computers and job-related software programs.
  
4. Knowledge of customer service techniques.
  
5. Knowledge of water safety protocols and instructional methods.
  
6. Knowledge of basic marketing and promotional practices.
  
7. Knowledge of Lifeguard, Water Safety Instructor, and related certification requirements.
  
8. Knowledge of GRPA and relevant athletic governing body rules and procedures.
  
9. Skill in math and grammar.
  
10. Skill in interpersonal relations.
  
11. Skill in oral and written communication.
  
12. Skill in scheduling and record keeping.
  
  
SUPERVISORY CONTROLS
  
The Athletics & Aquatics Manager assigns work based on general instructions. The supervisor spot-checks completed work for compliance with procedures, accuracy, and the nature and propriety of the final results.
  
  
GUIDELINES
  
Guidelines include American Red Cross Lifeguard, CPR, First Aid & AED standards; GRPA and relevant athletic association rules; department program policies; the Americans with Disabilities Act; and related city, state, and/or federal mandates or guidelines. These guidelines require judgment, selection, and interpretation in application.
  
  
COMPLEXITY/SCOPE OF WORK
  

* The work consists of varied program planning, supervisory, and coordination duties. Competing priorities across aquatic and athletic program areas and the need to balance community demand with available resources contribute to the complexity of the position.
* The purpose of this position is to plan and deliver high-quality aquatic and athletic programs that provide opportunities for residents of all ages. Success in this position contributes to increased participation and positive community engagement through recreation programming.

  
CONTACTS
  

* Contacts are typically with department employees, the Athletics & Aquatics Manager, Aquatics Operations Coordinator, Aquatics Facility Coordinator, youth league organizations, coaches, instructors, Community Center staff, Event Coordinator, outside vendors, and members of the general public.
* Contacts are typically to provide services, to give or exchange information, and/or to motivate.

  
PHYSICAL DEMANDS/ WORK ENVIRONMENT
  

* The work is typically performed while intermittently sitting, standing, or stooping. The employee frequently lifts light and heavy objects, climbs ladders, distinguishes between shades of color, and must be able to swim competently to complete life-saving techniques when required.
* The work is typically performed in an office, in a noisy place, or outdoors, occasionally in cold or inclement weather. The employee may be exposed to contagious or infectious diseases or irritating chemicals. The work may require the use of protective devices such as masks, goggles, and gloves.

  
SUPERVISORY AND MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITY
  
This position has functional supervision over assigned facility attendants and concession staff during operational hours. Functional supervision typically involves the ability to assign, coordinate, and review the quality and quantity of work of other employees.
  
  
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Baccalaureate degree in a course of study related to the occupational field required; and
* More than three years of related experience in aquatics pro

jobs.description:
Some of our clients have worked with us for years. Your job is to take care of them and help them find the next credit they qualify for.

We're hiring an outside account manager to work with our existing clients. These businesses already know us. We want someone in front of them in person, getting to know their owners and finance teams.

**What you'll do**

You'll work alongside one of our senior advisors, who manages a large share of our client relationships. You'll visit clients regularly, follow up after projects are done, work with the CPAs who serve these clients, and bring new opportunities back to the team. You'll learn the tax credit side as you go.

**How we work**

Our clients are business owners, and they want to see us in person. Email doesn't build those relationships. If you'd rather manage accounts from your inbox, this isn't the job.

**What's hard about it**

There's no script. You'll manage a lot of client relationships at once, so you need to stay organized and follow through. You'll also travel regularly to clients within a couple hours' drive of Atlanta.

**Who you are**

Maybe you've managed accounts for a payroll company, an insurance agency, a bank or a distributor. You don't need a tax or accounting background. You do need to be someone who:

* Does what they say they'll do
* Is comfortable sitting down with a business owner or CFO
* Spots opportunities and brings them back to the team
* Stays organized across a lot of clients
* Wants coaching and is teachable

**Pay and benefits**

$70,000 base. With bonus and commission, you can earn $100,000 to $110,000. Benefits include health, dental, vision, an HSA, a 401(k) with match, and paid time off.

You'll be based in the Atlanta area. When you're not on the road, you work remotely.

**About TaxCredible**

We help companies claim tax credits they've earned but often don't know exist. Our clients range from manufacturers to tech companies to quick-service restaurants. It's work that actually shows up on our clients' bottom line.

How to apply

Apply here and answer two questions in two or three sentences each:

* Tell us about a client relationship you kept through a hard moment.
* How do you use AI to stay on top of your clients or your work?

Then take our two Predictive Index assessments (about 15 minutes total): https://assessment.predictiveindex.com/bo/628K/BDR. We review applications once the assessments are done, and we move fast for the right candidate.

**Position: Sales Development Representative**

**Location: United States, Remote**

*This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.*

**ABOUT THE COMPANY:**

Revenue is complex, and clarity is rare. Our mission at Salesloft is to transform revenue complexity into clear, decisive action for every team driving growth.

We're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, where humans and AI work together to make confident decisions based on real signals. Thousands of customers run on our platforms every day, which gives us Revenue Context: a view into what happens in a deal, when, and with what outcome.

Our vision is a future where revenue growth is predictable and the teams driving it are unstoppable. If you want to help build it, alongside people who Move as One and let Evidence over Ego guide the work, we'd love to meet you.

**THE OPPORTUNITY:**

Be the first conversation that shows our future customers what Salesloft can do for them.

As our Inbound Sales Development Representative, you'll be the first human voice for people wanting to learn more about Salesloft. You'll work to understand who they are, what they care about, and what they're trying to achieve before connecting them with the right sales member. This is a role built to be a way in the door to a career in revenue at Salesloft. In your first six months you will:

* Respond to inbound interest quickly and with relevance, using signals and context rather than a generic script
* Run discovery conversations that qualify real needs and book high-quality meetings for Account Executives
* Build a working command of our story, our product, and our customers' world, and use Salesloft the way our customers do, so you can speak with credibility about it

**HOW YOU'LL WORK HERE** *(our values, in this role)*

* **Move as One:** You'll work daily with AEs, Marketing, and SDR peers, handing off cleanly and sharing credit for the wins you help create.
* **Evidence over Ego:** You'll let your experience and every day results drive your actions in the future - better meetings, better pitch, better experience.
* **Lead from the Front:** You'll take ownership early, whether it's a better handoff, a sharper question, or helping the next SDR ramp, with or without a title that says you should.
* **Make Your Mark:** You'll give feedback on messaging, routing, and process, and help shape how we engage inbound demand, not just run the playbook.
* **Customer-Inspired:** You'll turn what prospects tell you into insights that inform what Marketing, Sales, and Product build and say.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**  
You're curious, coachable, and energized by conversations with people you've never met. You're early in your career, or changing into it, and you want a structured place to learn how B2B revenue teams work. For this job, customer-centric mentality, attention to detail, and process-orientation mean more than direct sales experience. If you want to learn more, do more, and become more, this is your next move.

**YOU'LL BRING**

* A track record of clear, confident communication in writing and conversation (work, school, volunteering, or customer-facing roles all count)
* Evidence that you take feedback and improve quickly, with a specific example of something you got better at
* Comfort learning new tools and technical concepts and explaining them simply
* Organization and follow-through when juggling many conversations and tasks at once
* Genuine interest in a career in sales or revenue, and openness to a 1-2 year path in this role before moving on to your next step

**IT'S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE**

* Experience in customer-facing, service, or sales-adjacent work
* Familiarity with a CRM or sales engagement tool (Salesloft, ideally)
* Exposure to B2B software or SaaS
* Experience working toward goals or metrics in a team setting

**THE TEAM**

Our SDR team reports into the marketing organization, but you'll work alongside Sales, Marketing, and RevOps. You'll be learning from all sides of the business, while getting hands-on experience with our customers and prospects. You'll be trained with our solutions and will use them daily. Your immediate team is all US based, so it's easy to collaborate and ask questions. While the job is individual in nature when it comes to goals, you'll have support from a fellow SDR, a manager that's been at Salesloft for 4+ years, and confidence knowing that this role has only been opened due to an internal promotion. This is a great entry point to get into Salesloft.

*Your well-being matters to us. We offer a competitive, holistic benefits program designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health at every stage of your life and career. For full details on coverage options, wellness incentives, and perks, explore our benefits overview at* *https://salesloftbenefits.com/*

*At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.*

*We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

*If you're excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!*

**What is Exoticca?**

Exoticca is a pioneering online travel agency that has revolutionized the conception, production, and e-commerce of long-distance dream trips. At the core of Exoticca's brand equity is the commitment to "creating life milestones." We believe in delivering best-value trips, exploring unique destinations, curating extraordinary travel experiences, and demonstrating genuine care for both our customers and the planet.  
  
We are a professional, dynamic, multicultural team in rapid international growth, seeking new partners to help us create the best and most forward-thinking travel company of our generation.

**What do we do?**

Our B2B Sales Team is responsible for developing and growing Exoticca's network of Travel Advisors and agency partners across North America. Through a combination of field sales, training, account activation and relationship management, the team helps Travel Advisors discover Exoticca, understand our product and ultimately grow their business with us.

**What will you do?**  
The Sales Representative (B2B) is a field-based sales role focused on developing and growing Exoticca's Tier 2 and Tier 3 agency accounts (Silver & Bronze) within an assigned territory. This is a hands-on, execution-focused position with a strong emphasis on in-person agency visits, account activation and high-frequency market coverage.

You will work closely with the Business Development Managers and the broader B2B Sales Team to ensure that our Silver and Bronze accounts receive regular commercial attention, product education and support, helping them increase their engagement and bookings with Exoticca.

**Your main responsibilities will include:**  

* Visit Travel Agencies regularly across the assigned territory, maintaining a consistent and high-frequency field presence.
* Manage and develop a portfolio primarily composed of Silver and Bronze account (Tier 2 & Tier 3) within Exoticca's Loyalty Program.
* Build strong relationships with Travel Advisors and agency teams, becoming their day-to-day commercial point of contact.
* Activate and grow existing accounts, helping Travel Advisors move from registration to first booking and from occasional to more frequent production.
* Identify opportunities to reactivate dormant and low-producing accounts.
* Educate Travel Advisors on Exoticca's destinations, products, promotions, booking tools and Loyalty Program.
* Conduct in-person product presentations, agency trainings and webinars.
* Identify potential new agency partners and support the acquisition and activation of new accounts.
* Promote group opportunities and identify potential group business within the assigned portfolio.
* Attend relevant trade shows, industry events, conferences and FAM trips when required.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date information on account activity, visits and commercial opportunities in CRM.
* Work closely with Business Development Managers to identify accounts with significant growth potential that may require additional commercial support.
* Meet agreed activity and performance KPIs, including agency visits, account activation, booking activity and portfolio development.

The emphasis on frequent field coverage and a recurring visit pattern is intentional: the Sales Representative role is designed to provide more intensive market coverage than the more senior BDM structure.

 **Requirements**  

* 1–2 years of experience in sales, business development, account management on the travel industry.
* Experience within the travel industry is preferred, but we are also open to candidates with strong sales potential and a genuine interest in travel.
* Strong commercial mindset and enthusiasm for developing customer relationships.
* Comfortable spending a significant amount of time in the field visiting Trave Agencies.
* Self-motivated and comfortable managing a territory and daily visit schedule independently.
* Strong communication, interpersonal and presentation skills.
* Comfortable conducting small group presentations, product training and webinars.
* Organized and disciplined in managing follow-ups and CRM activity.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-changing and international environment.
* Willingness to learn, receive hands-on coaching and develop within the organization.
* Availability to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory and occasionally attend industry events and FAM trips.
* Fluency in Spanish is a plus.

  
**Benefits**  

* Competitive compensation package in line with job responsibilities and experience.
* Travel packages at reduced prices!
* English/Spanish lesson, bi-annual company parties.
* Referral bonus, if you bring people as talented as you.
* And last but not least, becoming part of a fun and motivated multicultural team at an agile and rapid growing organization!

Join Exoticca and play a pivotal role in creating life milestones through unforgettable travel experiences! This is your opportunity to shape the future of a dynamic and innovative travel brand on a global scale.

**Entry Level Medical Sales Representative – Nationwide Travel | $73K Base + Bonus**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Company:** Skilled Wound Care  
**Location:** Atlanta, GA (Field-Based, Extensive Overnight Travel: 4–5 Days per Week)  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | Entry Level  
**Salary:** $73,000 Base Salary + Uncapped Bonus Potential  
**Industry:** Healthcare Sales | Medical Sales | Wound Care | Skilled Nursing & Long-Term Care

### **Launch Your Medical Sales Career With Paid Training and Mentorship**

Skilled Wound Care is hiring an Entry Level Medical Sales Representative (Business Development Associate) for a nationwide, field-based travel role. If you're a recent college graduate or early-career professional who wants to break into healthcare sales, this role gives you structured sales training, mentorship from senior sales leaders, and a clear path to a full closing role.

No medical sales experience required. We're looking for drive, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.

At Skilled Wound Care, we don't just fill roles. We build partnerships, and our culture is the foundation of everything we do. You'll join a team that pushes each other to grow, shows up for one another, and shares in each other's wins. We work hard, we have fun doing it, and we believe a great culture isn't a perk. It's how we operate every day.

### **Why Start Your Healthcare Sales Career at Skilled Wound Care?**

* **Competitive entry-level pay:** a $73,000 base salary plus bonus potential that grows as you start closing accounts.
* **Mentorship from senior sales leaders:** you're never alone. Your challenges become our challenges, and your wins become our wins.
* **Clear career path:** we develop leaders from within, and many of our senior closers started right where you are.
* **Your voice matters:** your ideas carry weight, and you help build the vision, not just carry it out.
* **Integrity-first sales culture:** no shortcuts and no pressure tactics. We win the right way.
* **Full sales cycle exposure:** hands-on experience in B2B healthcare sales within the Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) and Long-Term Care (LTC) industry.

### **What You'll Do as a Business Development Associate**

* **Prospecting and sales support:** learn and help with prospecting, outreach, lead generation, and relationship-building with Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNFs) and Long-Term Care facilities nationwide, working alongside experienced closers.
* **Territory development:** help identify target accounts and learn how territory management and national market expansion strategy come together in the field.
* **Consultative and clinical value selling:** learn to explain the ROI of our physician-led wound care model to facility administrators, owners, and other decision-makers. Training and coaching are provided.
* **Relationship management:** build your own professional network with SNF staff, facility owners, and regional directors, mentored by senior team members.
* **Team collaboration:** share field insights, ask questions, and contribute to a team sales strategy that lifts everyone.

### **About the Travel: A True Road Warrior Role**

This is a **field-based medical sales role with extensive nationwide travel**. Expect to be on the road **4–5 days per week, including overnight stays**, visiting Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNFs) and Long-Term Care facilities in markets across the United States.

This role is a great fit if you:

* Enjoy being in the field, face-to-face with customers, rather than behind a desk
* Like a fast-paced schedule where every week looks different
* Are comfortable spending most weeknights away from home in hotels
* Want accelerated, hands-on experience across multiple healthcare markets nationwide

We're upfront about the travel because the right person will thrive on it, and it's one of the fastest ways to build your skills, your network, and your earning potential in healthcare sales.

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required (business, marketing, communications, health sciences, or related fields encouraged)
* 0–2 years of experience in sales, customer service, hospitality, retail, or a related field. **Recent college graduates and internship experience are welcome.**
* Strong interest in healthcare, medical sales, or business development
* Team-first mindset, coachability, and the drive to learn and grow independently
* Willingness to travel extensively nationwide: 4–5 days per week with frequent overnight stays
* Valid U.S. driver's license
* Ability to lift and carry up to 25 lbs

### **Compensation & Benefits**

* **Base salary:** $73,000
* **Bonus potential:** earn more as you begin closing accounts, with no ceiling as you grow into a full closing role
* Weekly education and leadership development
* Direct mentorship from senior sales leaders
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) and life insurance
* Paid time off (PTO)

### **Apply Today**

If you're eager to learn, ready for life on the road, and want a team that will invest in your growth from day one, **apply now** to join Skilled Wound Care as an Entry Level Medical Sales Representative.

*Skilled Wound Care is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age (40 or older), disability, or genetic information.*

Overwatch is a service-disabled Veteran-owned small business (SDVOB) certified through the National Veterans Business Development Council (NVBDC), offering construction professional services, talent acquisition, and general contractor services for the mission-critical infrastructure industry.

Our mission is the construction and management of state-of-the-art data centers with the precision and reliability this industry demands. From high-end engineers to seasoned professionals, we deploy the people you need to get your data center off the ground. At Overwatch, it's more than a job. It's a purpose.

**Overview**

Office-based **Assistant Project Manager** supporting the team Atlanta-area construction. This is a junior-to-mid construction process and document-control role, not a senior field PM. The **Assistant Project Manager** keeps current, accurate information flowing among the GC, consultants, design partners, and internal stakeholders.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Own RFIs and submittals from log-in through follow-up and closeout.
* Maintain drawing revisions, field bulletins, specifications, meeting minutes, action items, and technical project correspondence.
* Ensure the GC receives the correct and current project information.

**Project Controls Support**

* Support cost reports, budget-versus-actual tracking, change-order logs, pay applications, schedule updates, look-aheads, and early identification of cost or schedule risks.
* These duties support the role but do not replace the primary focus on construction documentation and follow-through.

**Coordination**

* Coordinate directly with the GC, consultants, subcontractors, design teams, and the team stakeholders.
* Attend meetings, document decisions, issue clear follow-ups, and drive open items to resolution.

**Working Style**

* Task-oriented, reliable, accountable, and execution-first. Strong self-management and follow-up skills.
* Comfortable in a support role, willing to put in extra effort when needed, and able to communicate directly and honestly

**Driver’s License Requirement**

For roles that require on-site presence or travel between work locations as an essential function of the position, candidates must possess and maintain a valid driver’s license appropriate for the role and be eligible to operate a motor vehicle in accordance with applicable laws.

**Communication Skills**

Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively in a professional work environment, including preparing written reports and documentation, conveying information clearly to team members, clients, and stakeholders, and responding appropriately to verbal and written communications related to job duties.

**Physical Requirements and Work Environment**

This position operates primarily in an active data center construction environment, encompassing both indoor and outdoor work settings. The role requires the physical ability to perform essential job functions safely and effectively in a dynamic environment that includes ongoing construction activity and evolving site conditions.

The work environment includes areas and temporary structures owned, leased, or controlled by third parties over which Overwatch may have limited or no control. Because the project remains under construction, certain areas of the site — including access routes, staging zones, and temporary structures — may not yet be fully ADA-compliant until construction is complete or those third-party areas are finalized.

**Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to walk, stand, stoop, twist, bend, and climb stairs or ladders for extended periods while navigating uneven, unpaved, or obstructed terrain.

**Position Title:** Community Outreach Specialist – Family Connects Chicago (FCC) Community Alignment – West Region

**Department:** Foster Care

**Reports to**: Community Alignment Manager

  

**About the Program:**

The Family Connects Chicago (FCC) Community Alignment System strengthens the ecosystem of supports for birthing people and newborns by improving hyperlocal outreach, referral coordination, and community voice in neighborhoods experiencing the greatest disparities in infant mortality and maternal health outcomes. UCAN will serve as the Community Alignment Delegate for the West Region, embedding FCC within trusted West Side networks. The program advances CDPH’s four objectives: (1) outreach in priority areas; (2) systems improvement to strengthen referral pathways; (3) community engagement to elevate parent voice; and (4) coordination to ensure a unified citywide system. UCAN’s established trauma-informed infrastructure in North Lawndale and Garfield Park allows immediate implementation. The program formalizes navigation and alignment activities that UCAN already performs, ensuring that families identified through FCC nurse home visits are successfully connected to behavioral health, housing supports, food access, safe sleep resources, and other essential services.

  

**Position Objective and Summary:**

The Community Outreach Specialist is a frontline, community-based role responsible for engaging West Side residents, raising awareness of Family Connects Chicago (FCC), and connecting pregnant and postpartum caregivers to navigation, resources, and infant essentials through hyperlocal outreach and events.

* Conduct door-to-door canvassing, tabling, and other outreach activities in priority West Region neighborhoods.

RB Global full-time employees are offered medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurances. Employees are able to enroll in our company’s 401k plan and RB Global will match 100% for the first 4% contributed. Employees will also receive 15 days of PTO each year.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Front is the customer operations platform built for B2B complexity, keeping every team, tool, and customer conversation in sync so companies can scale without losing connection. Others handle simple interactions. Front handles the coordination and context behind complex B2B customer relationships. Over 9,000 companies, including Uber Freight, Navan, and Stripe, rely on Front because it's the only one that can run the operational layer that makes customer-facing work actually succeed.

Backed by Sequoia Capital and Salesforce Ventures, Front has raised $204M from leading venture capital firms and independent investors including top executives at Atlassian, Okta, Qualtrics, Zoom, and PagerDuty. Front has received numerous accolades, including a **Certified Great Place to Work in 2026,** **Top Places to Work by USA Today 2025**, **Y Combinator's list of Top Companies in 2023**, **#4 on Fortune’s Best Workplaces in the Bay Area** ,**Inc. Magazine's 2022 Best Workplaces list**, and **Forbes Best Startup Employers 2022 List**.

As an Account Manager at Front, you will own the commercial health and growth of a portfolio of customers. This is a relationship-driven role where you’ll manage renewals, uncover expansion opportunities, and help customers get more value from Front over time.

You’ll partner closely with a dedicated Customer Success Manager (CSM). While the CSM focuses on product adoption and value realization, you will own the commercial relationship—building trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, navigating complex opportunities, and delivering predictable revenue outcomes. This role is a great fit for someone who combines commercial acumen, customer empathy, and operational rigor.

**What will you be doing?**

* **Own the commercial lifecycle:** Manage renewals and expansion opportunities across a portfolio of core customers, from early planning through negotiation and close.
* **Drive revenue growth:** Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities, run thoughtful discovery, build business cases, negotiate contracts, and close commercial deals.
* **Build trusted customer relationships:** Develop strong relationships with customer stakeholders and understand their goals, challenges, and evolving business needs.
* Position Front’s broader value: Introduce AI capabilities like Autopilot, Professional Services, premium support, and other relevant offerings to help customers automate workflows, accelerate time-to-value, and expand their use of Front.
* **Partner with Customer Success:** Collaborate closely with your mapped CSM to use product usage data, health signals, and customer feedback to drive expansion and mitigate churn risk.
* **Lead strategic account planning:** Create and execute account plans that align customer priorities with Front’s capabilities and identify paths to long-term growth.
* **Maintain operational excellence:** Keep accurate CRM records, manage pipeline, forecast renewals and expansion, and consistently track customer and commercial activity.
* **Collaborate cross-functionally:** Partner with Sales, Support, Product, Marketing, and Services to resolve issues, advocate for customer feedback, and improve the customer experience.

**What skills and experience do you need?**

* **Experience:** 3–5 years in Account Management, Customer Success, or a related commercial role, ideally managing and growing a portfolio of SaaS customers.
* **Commercial acumen:** A track record of owning revenue outcomes, including renewals, upsell, cross-sell, or expansion in a quota-carrying or metrics-driven environment.
* **Customer relationship skills:** Ability to build credibility with a range of stakeholders, understand business priorities, and communicate value clearly.
* **Strategic and consultative approach:** Strong discovery, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect customer needs to practical solutions.
* **Cross-functional collaboration:** Experience partnering with Customer Success, Support, Product, Services, and other teams to deliver customer and business outcomes.
* **Operational rigor:** Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple opportunities, timelines, and stakeholders without losing momentum.
* **Data fluency:** Ability to interpret customer usage, engagement, and health data to prioritize action and make informed commercial decisions.
* AI fluency: Comfort leveraging AI tools and Front’s AI capabilities to improve productivity, identify customer opportunities, and demonstrate value.
* **SaaS experience:** Experience working in B2B SaaS is required; experience with customer experience, support, collaboration, or communications products is a plus.

**Front operates on a hybrid model — we come together in the office each Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday to collaborate and stay connected.**

**What we offer**

* Competitive salary
* Equity (we are post-series D & backed by some of the best VCs in the US)
* Private health insurance, including plan options at no cost to employees
* Paid parental leave
* Flexible time off policy
* Flexibility to work from home Monday and Friday, unless posted as a fully remote role
* Mental health support with Workplace Options
* Family planning support with Maven
* $100 per month Lifestyle Stipend to spend on fitness, health and wellness, and other activities
* Wellness Days - Fronteers get an additional day off on months with no holidays
* Winter Break - Our offices are closed from Christmas to New Year's Day!

*Front provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability. By applying, you acknowledge and agree that you have read and understand the* *California Recruiting Privacy Notice* *&* *EU Privacy Notice*

Compensation Range: $143K - $163K

jobs.title: Key Account Manager (Chicago-based)
jobs.description:
**Reports to: VP, Go-To-Market**

**Location: Chicago, IL (must be based in Chicago).**

**Remote-first with regular time in our partners' Chicago offices**

**Travel: Regular, including race weekends and race week**

**The role in one sentence**
----------------------------

**You'll be Let's Do This's person on the ground in Chicago: embedded with a World Marathon Major, trusted by its team as one of their own, and accountable for making our technology move their business forward this year and for years to come.**

**About the role**
------------------

**Our US business is growing fast, and Chicago is at the heart of it. We're looking for a Key Account Manager to own our relationship with the Chicago-based organizer of a World Marathon Major and its year-round event portfolio, alongside a small number of other strategic US partners.**

**This isn't an account you manage from a dashboard. You'll spend real time in our partner's offices, at their planning meetings and on their start lines. You'll learn their mission, their values and the pressures behind every decision, well enough to anticipate what they need before they ask. Then you'll bring that understanding back into Let's Do This, so our product, our people and our AI tools are pointed at what matters most to them.**

**You'll be the partner's voice inside LDT and LDT's voice inside the partner. Holding both, credibly and at the same time, is the job.**

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

**In your first 90 days**

* **You know the partner's team, goals, calendar and pain points as well as anyone at LDT**
* **You've built a joint account plan with their leadership covering the year ahead**
* **You've become the first call for their team, with faster answers and fewer escalations**

**In your first 12 months**

* **You've led the partner through a full event cycle, from registration open to race day and the debrief after**
* **Revenue, renewal readiness and account health across your portfolio are up and to the right**
* **At least one manual workflow at each partner has been replaced with an AI-enabled one**
* **Partners describe LDT as a strategic partner, not a vendor, and would recommend us to their peers**

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Embed with our flagship Chicago partner**

* **Spend regular time onsite with the partner's team, so you're part of how they plan, operate and make decisions**
* **Understand their mission and values deeply, and represent them faithfully inside LDT**
* **Build trusted relationships at every level, from day-to-day operations to senior leadership**
* **Anticipate needs across their event calendar, not just their biggest weekend**

### **Own commercial performance and retention**

* **Own revenue performance, retention and renewals across your portfolio**
* **Build and drive multi-quarter account strategies tied to each partner's goals**
* **Keep account health strong and renewal readiness high, flagging risk early and clearly**
* **Find and land growth opportunities that measurably improve partner performance**

### **Be the bridge between their ambitions and our technology**

* **Translate the partner's strategic goals into how LDT's platform, integrations and data should work for them**
* **Act as a technical advisor on registration, participant experience, data flows and integrations**
* **Turn partner needs into clear, prioritized product insight, and partner with Product to shape the roadmap**
* **Make sure partners adopt and get full value from new features, including our AI-powered products and agents**

### **Work AI-first**

* **Use LDT's internal AI tools, alongside external tools, to generate insights, prioritize actions and scale your impact**
* **Deliver data-driven recommendations on performance trends, conversion and operational efficiency**
* **Help partners move from manual, LDT-supported workflows to AI-enabled, self-sufficient ones**
* **Ask "how do I 10x my impact with AI?" rather than "how do I do more manually?"**

### **Show up when it matters**

* **Be onsite for race week and race weekends, supporting partners at their most critical moments**
* **Expect a minimum of 5 weekends a year across your portfolio, with more around peak events**
* **Build trust through hands-on presence, calm under pressure and fast problem-solving**

### **Lead across LDT and the industry**

* **Keep internal teams clear on account health, priorities and risks**
* **Work with Sales, Product and the wider GTM team to give partners a seamless experience**
* **Build credibility in the endurance events community and represent LDT at industry events**

**About you**
-------------

* **4+ years in key account management, technical account management, strategic customer success or a similar role**
* **A track record of owning revenue, retention or expansion targets**
* **Experience embedding with a major client, or working inside one, so you know how to be part of their team while delivering for your own**
* **Strong technical fluency: you're comfortable with APIs, integrations and data flows, and can explain them to non-technical stakeholders**
* **Excellent stakeholder management, including C-level**
* **Real curiosity about AI tools, automation and data, and evidence you've used them to scale your own output**
* **Comfortable in ambiguity, and good at building structure where there isn't any**

**Bonus points**

* **Experience in endurance events, mass-participation sport, live events or ticketing**
* **Roots in the Chicago running or sports community**
* **You've worked a race day, from either side of the start line**

**You are**

* **Commercially minded and results-driven**
* **Credible, consultative, and genuinely liked and trusted by partners**
* **Mission-led: you care about what your partners care about**
* **Confident working remotely while building tight, respected relationships with colleagues**
* **Energized by high growth, big moments and going above

In 1976, ten independent hauliers joined forces and founded DSV in Denmark. Since then, DSV has evolved to become the world's 3rd largest supplier of global solutions within transport and logistics. Today, we add value to our customers' entire supply chain by transporting, storing, packaging, re-packaging, processing and clearing all types of goods. We work every day from our many offices in more than 80 countries to ensure a steady supply of goods to production lines, outlets, stores and consumers all over the world. Our reach is global yet our presence is local and close to our customers. Read more at www.dsv.com

This role is critical to the successful delivery of safe and secure environments for high-profile sports, entertainment, and community events. The Security Manager ensures all security staff are trained, deployed, and managed in accordance with company policies, client expectations, and regulatory standards.

**Pay, Benefits, and Work Location:**

* **Competitive Salary: $70,000 - $75,000 / year**
* **Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and more.**
* **Work Location: Evanston, IL, you’ll be at the heart of our operations**

 **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Lead all aspects of event security planning, including staffing, access control, credentialing, ingress/egress strategy, and emergency response planning.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for the venue and client partners on all event security matters.

The Adler Planetarium connects people to the universe and each other. For over 120 years, Gordon Food Service has delivered the excellence, expertise, and quality products our customers need to design successful food operations and experiences. We've grown to be the largest family-operated broadline food distribution company in North America by being passionately committed to the people we serve.

  

At Gordon Food Service, our customers come first. As an Outside Food Sales Representative, you will cultivate relationships, develop new business, and provide innovative solutions to our customers, helping them to achieve their goals and, in return, yours!

**This position will reside in: Downtown Chicago, IL**

**Position Benefits**

* A generous 401(k) matching program that is above industry standards
* Financial rewards for performance compensation structure which includes salary, commission, and bonuses
* Low-cost benefit options for you and your family's health and future
* An Automobile expense reimbursement plan
* Cell phone reimbursement plan

**Outside Food Sales Representative**

We invite you to join our sales team where you’ll experience a world where servant leadership and cutting-edge tools and training come together to support your career growth and financial objectives.

  

As an Outside Food Sales Representative, you’ll be responsible for the overall sales and relationship management efforts for existing and prospective customers within your assigned territory. This includes pursuing new customers, deepening and strengthening existing customer relationships, and sales territory management.

  

**Pursuing New Customers**

* Researching industry and market trends impacting restaurants within your territory
* Identifying and researching prospective customers within your territory
* Developing sales strategies that highlight products, services, values, and solutions offered by Gordon Food Service and presenting the sales strategy to prospective customers

**Deepen and Strengthen Existing Customer Relationships**

* Visiting all customers within the assigned territory on a weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly basis
* Conducting business reviews to determine existing customers needs and areas of opportunity for growing sales
* Providing ongoing training to customers on Gordon Food Service product offerings
* Identifying opportunities within existing customers businesses where Gordon Food Service can add value through product and service offerings

**Sales Territory Management**

* Balancing new customers acquisition and deepening and strengthening existing customer relationships
* Coordinating visits to prospective customers and existing customers
* Communicating order status and order processing updates to customers

**Sales Training - Getting you Ready**

Gordon Food Service’s goal during your first 90 days is to set you up for success! This includes engaging you in various training offerings, including e-learning, classroom sessions, video roleplays, job shadowing, and peer sales representative mentorship. Throughout your first 90 days, you will learn:

  

* How to use Gordon Food Service systems, processes, and tools to manage customer relationships
* About the products available to Gordon Food Service customers
* The sales process for engaging new customers
* How to establish your relationships in the vast network of resources available to you, a Gordon Food Service sales representative
* Best practices on developing relationships with current and prospective customers
* Strategies on how to effectively manage your territory

**Position Requirements**

* High School Diploma/GED is required
* Bachelor's degree and/or culinary certificate preferred
* 1 year of prior sales, business, or food service experience
* Maintaining a valid state driver's license and a safe driving record
* Ability to obtain your food safety certification

Gordon Food Service encourages v eterans and active military members to apply

**BE PART OF AN AMAZING CULTURE WHERE WHAT MATTERS TO YOU, MATTERS TO US!**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Gordon Food Service values our customers and understands that their success is largely dependent upon their workforce. To demonstrate our commitment to our partnership, we will require any candidate who works for a Gordon Food Service customer to provide a letter of support from their management if they are selected for the interview process.

Equal Employment Opportunity is a matter of policy at Gordon Food Service, Inc. and we are committed to a work environment in which all individuals are treated with respect and dignity.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, status as a protected veteran, or status as a qualified individual with disability. If you require reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process due to a disability, please submit your request to talent@gfs.com and use the words “Accommodation Request” in your subject line.

All Gordon Food Service locations are tobacco-free.

Gordon Food Service is a drug-free workplace and conducts pre-employment drug tests.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Syndigo gets great products chosen. Every choice in commerce, whether by a shopper, a search engine, a marketplace, or an AI assistant, is made on product data, and our software makes that data complete and trusted and moves it across the industry's largest two-sided commerce network: 15,000+ brands and 3,500+ retailers. Companies like AutoZone, Colgate-Palmolive, Dole International, Unilever, and Walgreens trust Syndigo to get their products chosen. Learn more at www.syndigo.com.

**\*\*This is a hybrid position that requires 2 days per week in office at our Chicago location\*\***

  

As an **Enterprise Customer Success Manager**, you will own the post-sale relationship for a portfolio of Syndigo's largest and most valued customers. You will act as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, driving measurable business outcomes, product adoption, retention, and expansion across complex, multi-threaded enterprise accounts.

You will manage a book of business of approximately 15–18 enterprise customers, fostering strong partnerships through a deep understanding of each customer's business objectives, priorities, and challenges

**HOW WE'LL BE WINNING TOGETHER DAY TO DAY**

* Customer Value & Outcomes
  + Own the end-to-end success of assigned enterprise accounts following implementation
  + Establish, document, and track customer goals, success metrics, and ROI realization plans
  + Lead recurring executive-level conversations focused on value delivered, business impact, and strategic alignment
* Relationship Management
  + Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders (Director, VP, C-level)
  + Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation owner for assigned accounts, internally and externally
  + Lead structured performance reviews (including QBRs) that highlight outcomes, insights, risks, and next steps while driving ongoing discovery
* Adoption & Retention
  + Drive deep product adoption across customer teams and use cases
  + Identify adoption barriers, limitations, and risks, and partner with customers to remove roadblocks
  + Document risk within ChurnZero and proactively develop and execute mitigation and success plans with internal stakeholders
  + Collaborate with Commercial Sales and CSM Leadership to support customer renewals through insights and strategic guidance
* Growth & Expansion
  + Identify expansion opportunities through value discovery and product alignment, creating qualified lead pass opportunities for Sales
  + Partner with Account Executives to support upsell and cross-sell initiatives
* Advocacy
  + Identify, develop, and nurture customer advocates within your book of business
  + Proactively identify advocacy risk and develop mitigation strategies to preserve long-term relationships
  + Partner with internal teams to secure customer referrals, testimonials, and event speakers
* Cross-Functional Leadership
  + Serve as the voice of the customer internally, influencing Product, Support, and Services
  + Coordinate internal resources to deliver a seamless, high-quality enterprise customer experience

**WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU**

* 2-4 years of experience in a customer success role with demonstrated success in client relationship management in SaaS
* Experience managing a book of business in the $2–$3M ARR range
* ChurnZero experience is a plus
* Knowledge of the CPG industry is strongly preferred
* High degree of comfort with technology, particularly databases and syndicated data
* Strong presentation skills with the ability to communicate value and insights to professional and executive audiences
* Ability to work independently and make decisions across a wide range of complexity
* Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve customer challenges
* Demonstrated success working with both large, complex enterprises and mid-sized organizations

**Diversity, Equity & Inclusion**
---------------------------------

To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating. Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it's how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful!

All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth!

**GDPR/CCPA**

Syndigo, to process applications, holds onto data for a "reasonable time" after applications are submitted. This data is stored for Syndigo's internal use by HR/Recruiting Staff only. Verified requests for data deletion and exports will be completed upon request.

**Syndigo Job Applicant Privacy Notice**

At Syndigo, we care about your privacy. As you go through our recruitment process, we are committed to being transparent about how we process your personal data. To learn more about how Syndigo processes your personal data, go to our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.
